title: Credit Repair & Business Funding Systems Builder — Build-to-Hire Opportunity
description:
CREDIT REPAIR & BUSINESS FUNDING SYSTEMS BUILDER



Location: Philippines — Remote



Engagement: Paid Project With Long-Term Opportunity



Project Compensation: $3,000–$5,000 USD



Long-Term Compensation: $10–$15 USD per hour, plus potential performance incentives



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are building a US-based credit repair company, business funding company and Skool community.



We are looking for a talented and resourceful systems builder with previous experience in credit repair, business funding, or a related financial-services company.



This is not a basic administrative VA position. You do not need to have years of senior-level experience, but you must be technically capable, learn quickly and know how to turn ideas into organized systems.



We are not afraid to pay for talent. The right candidate will begin with a paid evaluation, advance into a milestone-based buildout, and be considered for a long-term position with the company.



WHAT YOU WILL HELP US BUILD



• Credit repair workflows and operating systems



• Business funding qualification and fulfillment systems



• A complete Skool classroom and community



• GoHighLevel pipelines, forms, calendars and automations



•
, SMS, onboarding and follow-up sequences



• CRM stages, tags, triggers, custom fields and dashboards



• Written and Loom-based SOPs



• Customer trackers, checklists, scripts and templates



• Google Drive file and training organization



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Previous experience in credit repair, business funding, or related financial services



• Hands-on experience building GoHighLevel workflows and automations



• Experience creating SOPs, process documentation and Loom training videos



• Strong knowledge of Google Docs, Google Sheets and Google Drive



• Experience using ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools



• Strong research, organization and problem-solving skills



• Excellent written and spoken English



• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines



Experience with Skool, Credit Repair Cloud, Zapier, Make, webhooks, credit disputes or funding applications is highly preferred.



ASSESSMENT REQUIREMENTS



• Verifiable C2 English proficiency



• Verifiable IQ assessment score of 130 or higher



If you have not completed these assessments, you must be willing to complete them before advancing to the interview stage.



COMPENSATION AND GROWTH



The selected candidate will begin with a paid evaluation project.



Candidates who pass will advance into a milestone-based buildout paying approximately $3,000–$5,000 USD, depending on experience and final project scope.



Top performers will be considered for a long-term independent-contractor position paying $10–$15 USD per hour, with opportunities for performance bonuses and increased responsibility.



Potential long-term positions include:



• Credit Repair Specialist/Disputer



• Business Funding Specialist



• GoHighLevel Automation Specialist



• Skool Community Administrator



• Operations and Systems Manager



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Your résumé



2. A two-to-three-minute Loom introduction



3. Your C2 English and IQ assessment results, if already completed



4. A short description of your credit repair or business funding experience



5. Examples of GoHighLevel automations, SOPs, workflows or dashboards you have personally created



6. Your availability and expected compensation



IN YOUR LOOM VIDEO, ANSWER:



1. What credit repair or business funding experience do you have?



2. What is one GoHighLevel automation you have personally built?



3. What is one process you improved at a previous company?



4. Why are you a strong fit for this opportunity?



Applications without a Loom video will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Recruiting in South Africa & Philippines

Australian-Based Award-Winning Digital Marketing Agency



About Us



We are an Australian-based, award-winning digital marketing agency specialising in PPC (Google Ads & Meta Ads) and CRO (Conversion Rate Optimisation).

Everything we do is built around two clear goals:



1. Help our clients generate more sales through smart, performance-driven marketing.

We use strategic paid media and conversion optimisation to drive measurable, scalable growth.



2. Produce award-level creative work that elevates brands.

We believe high-end design increases perceived value, builds credibility, and strengthens every marketing touchpoint — from ads and landing pages to brand identity and content assets.



We work across a wide range of industries — including insurance, e-commerce, pizza franchises, online florists, childcare centres, restaurants, trailers, containers, luxury accommodation, yachts, coaching businesses and more.



Our standard is simple: drive growth and create work we’re proud to win awards for.

Although we are based in Australia, this is a full-time remote position being recruited in South Africa and the Philippines.



The Role



We are looking for a Senior Graphic Designer (5+ years’ experience) who produces polished, high-end design and understands that creative work directly impacts commercial results.

This role is central to how our clients are perceived in their markets. Your work must elevate brand authority, increase perceived value, and support higher conversions across all marketing assets.

You will work across multiple clients and industries, helping us deliver both performance and award-level creative standards.



Key Responsibilities



You will be responsible for high-quality creative output across our client portfolio, including:



• Brand identity design

• Logo development

• Website design

• High-converting landing page design

• Social media ad creative (Meta, Google, display)

• Organic social media content

• Content marketing assets (eBooks, lead magnets, downloadable guides)

• Presentation design (PowerPoint, pitch decks, proposals)

• Marketing materials across digital platforms

Your work must be strategically aligned, commercially effective, and visually refined.



Experience & Skills Required



• 5+ years of professional design experience

• Strong portfolio demonstrating polished, premium, modern design

• Experience working across multiple industries and brand styles

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, XD, etc.)

• Comfortable using Canva when required

• Ability to design in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and format Excel sheets when necessary

• Strong understanding of branding, typography, layout, hierarchy, and user experience

• Experience in performance marketing environments is highly advantageous



Award-winning experience is advantageous, but not essential. What matters most is your standard of work and ambition to create best-in-class design.



Who This Role Is For?



This role is ideal for someone who:



• Has a genuine passion for high-end design

• Is quality-driven and refuses to produce average work

• Has a strong work ethic and consistently meets deadlines

• Thrives on refinement and attention to detail

• Welcomes feedback and uses it to improve outcomes

• Is excited about helping an agency win more awards

• Wants to help clients grow through premium, high-performance creative



You should want to be among the best in your field — and constantly improving.



Who This Role Is Not For?



This role is not suitable for someone who:



• Treats remote work casually or lacks discipline

• Works on multiple side projects during working hours

• Is looking for a secondary or part-time income

• Delivers “good enough” work instead of five-star work



This is a well-paid, full-time role. In return, we expect full commitment, focus, integrity, and excellence during working hours.

We maintain high standards, strong ethics, and a quality-driven team culture — and we protect that culture carefully.



What You’ll Gain



• Full-time remote flexibility

• Exposure to diverse and exciting industries

• Opportunity to contribute to award-winning campaigns

• A performance-driven, ambitious agency environment

• The chance to refine your craft at a high level

• Meaningful work that directly impacts client growth



How to Apply



If this sounds like you, please send:



• A link to your portfolio to 

• A short introduction explaining why this role would be perfect for you



If you have not heard back from us within 10 days of submitting your portfolio, please consider your application unsuccessful for progression to the next stage.

title: Senior SEO Specialist
description:
Senior SEO Specialist



Full-Time | Remote | Recruiting in Philippines

Australian-Based Award-Winning Digital Marketing Agency



About Us



We are an Australian-based, award-winning digital marketing agency specialising in PPC (Google Ads & Meta Ads) and CRO (Conversion Rate Optimisation).



Everything we do is built around two clear goals:



1. Help our clients generate more sales through smart, performance-driven marketing.

We use strategic paid media and conversion optimisation to drive measurable, scalable growth.



2. Produce award-level work that delivers real commercial impact.

From paid campaigns to organic search, our standard is simple — drive growth and create work we’re proud to win awards for.



We work across a wide range of industries including insurance, e-commerce, pizza franchises, florists, childcare centres, restaurants, trailers, containers, luxury accommodation, yachts, coaching businesses and more.



Although we are based in Australia, this is a full-time remote position being recruited in South Africa and the Philippines.



The Role



We are looking for a Senior SEO Specialist (5+ years’ experience) with a proven track record of delivering measurable organic growth that translates into real revenue.

This is not a role for someone who focuses on rankings alone.

We are looking for someone who understands that:



•	Rankings without traffic are meaningless

•	Traffic without conversions is vanity

•	SEO must generate measurable ROI



You will be accountable not just for ranking commercial keywords — but for driving qualified visitors and proving that the traffic generated produces leads and/or e-commerce sales.

If Google Ads dominates certain search results, you must know how to identify opportunities where organic traffic can still win and produce measurable commercial impact.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means:



•	Identifying revenue-driving keyword opportunities

•	Increasing qualified organic traffic

•	Improving rankings where real search demand exists

•	Demonstrating measurable ROI from SEO efforts

•	Contributing to increased leads and/or e-commerce revenue



We measure success by impact — not by activity.



Key Responsibilities



You will take full ownership of SEO strategy and implementation across our client portfolio.

On-Page SEO & Revenue-Focused Content



•	Conduct advanced keyword research focused on sales-driving intent

•	Identify high-impact keywords with real traffic potential

•	Avoid vanity rankings with no commercial value

•	Create and optimise high-quality, conversion-focused SEO content

•	Structure pages around search intent and conversion outcomes

•	Build strong internal linking strategies



Technical SEO



•	Conduct technical audits and resolve core issues

•	Improve crawlability, indexing, and site architecture

•	Optimise site speed and Core Web Vitals

•	Implement schema markup

•	Ensure technical health supports rankings and performance



Local SEO



•	Google Business Profile optimisation

•	Local search and map pack ranking improvements

•	Local citation strategy



AI & Modern Search Optimisation



•	Implement AI-informed optimisation strategies

•	Optimise for evolving AI-assisted search environments

•	Leverage AI tools responsibly to enhance productivity and results

•	Ensure social and content ecosystems support organic performance



You must be able to both develop strategy and execute implementation yourself.

We are not looking for someone who proposes ideas and blames others if results are not achieved.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership and proves performance.



Experience & Skills Required



•	5+ years of professional SEO experience

•	Proven track record of increasing rankings and qualified organic traffic

•	Clear evidence of SEO campaigns that generated measurable leads or revenue

•	Strong experience in on-page SEO and content creation

•	Deep understanding of technical SEO

•	Experience with Local SEO (Google Business Profile optimisation)

•	Strong commercial mindset — understands revenue impact

•	Experience using leading SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, etc.)

•	Ability to independently execute both strategy and implementation

You must be able to demonstrate past campaigns where SEO generated real ROI.



Accountability



You will be directly responsible for:

•	Increasing qualified organic traffic

•	Improving rankings for commercially valuable keywords with real search volume

•	Driving measurable growth in leads and/or e-commerce sales

•	Proving SEO ROI through data



We do not measure success by reports.

We measure success by results.



Who This Role Is For



This role is ideal for someone who:



•	Is commercially minded and ROI-focused

•	Has delivered proven SEO results in competitive markets

•	Can show real traffic growth that led to real revenue

•	Is a self-starter and works independently

•	Takes ownership of outcomes

•	Thrives in a performance-driven environment

•	Wants to contribute to an ambitious, award-winning agency

You should want to be known for delivering exceptional SEO performance — not just activity.



Who This Role Is Not For



This role is not suitable for someone who:



•	Focuses only on rankings without traffic

•	Cannot prove measurable results

•	Is still learning SEO fundamentals

•	Relies on others to implement strategy

•	Blames external factors for poor performance

•	Treats remote work casually

•	Is looking for a part-time or secondary income role



We are not looking for someone to “learn on our clients.”

We are looking for someone who already knows how to deliver measurable growth.



What You’ll Gain



•	Full-time remote flexibility

•	Exposure to diverse and competitive industries

•	Opportunity to deliver high-level SEO within a performance-driven agency

•	Work alongside PPC and CRO specialists

•	A results-focused, ambitious environment

•	The chance to build a reputation for measurable SEO excellence



How to Apply



If this sounds like you, please:



•
 Your CV to 

•	Clear case studies or proof of measurable SEO results

•	Evidence of traffic growth that generated leads or sales

•	A short introduction explaining why you are perfect for this role



If you have not heard back within 10 days of submitting your application, please consider your application unsuccessful for progression to the next stage.

title: Customer Support Rep (Fully Remote)
description:
We’re Hiring: Customer Support Rep (Fully Remote)

_____________________________________________________________



A rare opportunity to learn, grow, and help power one of the fastest-growing home brands

_____________________________________________________________



Hi! I’m Lawrence, founder of JazzUpCo - a fast-growing home and dining brand redefining modern tableware and lifestyle across the US. We are now expanding globally, and only just getting started.



Our vision is simple - when people think of beautifully designed, high-quality flatware and homeware, we want them to think of JazzUpCo.



We’ve served over 100,000+ customers and we’re growing fast - which means we’re now looking for someone thoughtful, reliable, and eager to grow, to support our operations and customer experience.



You’ll be part of the engine that keeps our day-to-day running smoothly - supporting our customers, organizing backend operations, and helping us improve how we work as we scale.

_____________________________________________________________



Your Role



You’ll with your team lead, and our customers. Your job is to make sure every customer experience is a smooth one - and that our backend operations stay organized as we grow.



_____________________________________________________________



What You’ll Do:



- Respond to customer inquiries via email, social, and chat platforms (we use Gorgias)



- Resolve issues with care and empathy, ensuring customers feel heard and helped



- Coordinate with warehouse and logistics partners to ensure smooth order fulfillment and tracking



- Monitor reviews, identify trends in feedback, and suggest improvements to our systems



- Support daily operations tasks - tracking returns, updating records, and keeping things organized



- Collaborate with the team to improve our SOPs and backend workflows



- Be the voice of the customer - bringing feedback to the team to help us improve



You don’t need to have all the answers - we’ll teach you the tools and systems. What we care about is your attitude: someone eager to learn, grow, and contribute ideas along the way.



_____________________________________________________________



Who We’re Looking For:



- Empathetic & Patient Communicator: You write and speak with warmth and clarity, and genuinely care about helping people.



- Reliable & Detail-Oriented: You keep things organized, catch the little things, and follow through consistently.



- Tech-Savvy & Process-Oriented: You enjoy systems, tools (Notion, Slack, Gorgias etc.), and figuring things out when things aren’t working.



- Eager to Grow: This is a full-time employee role - not a freelance or part-time gig. We’re looking for someone fully committed to growing with us long-term. You won’t be juggling other jobs. Instead, you’ll be part of the team, learning across different areas of the business, gaining new skills, and building something meaningful together.



- Team Player: You work well with others, ask good questions, and love contributing to a positive team vibe.



_____________________________________________________________



Why Work With Us:



- 100% remote, full-time role with paid time off and other benefits



- Learn directly from the founder and team lead with hands-on mentorship



- Join a high-growth brand where your work actually matters - no layers, no red tape



- Be part of a team that values excellence, growth, and fulfillment



_____________________________________________________________



Our Culture



We believe culture fit is key. Skills can be trained, but the right mindset, attitude, and shared values are what make the magic happen here. Our culture is built around 3 pillars:



E — Excel

If we’re going to do something, we do it with care and pride.



F — Fulfilment

We find meaning in the work we do - and how we do it.



G — Growth

We believe everything can be learned. And we’re committed to growing together, day by day.



_____________________________________________________________



The Journey Ahead:



Step 1: Apply - Tell us about yourself through the application form: forms.gle/xtq97FU5iZNyV9258



Step 2: Interview - If shortlisted, we’ll get to know you and see if it’s a good fit for both sides.



Step 3: Trial Task - A short task to see how you approach real situations.



Step 4: Offer & Onboarding - If it’s a match, we’ll kick off with a 60-day onboarding and probation period to get you trained up and integrated into the team.



At the end of this onboarding and probation phase, if we’re aligned and excited to move forward together, your position will be confirmed as a full-time team member - with continued mentorship, support, and a clear path for growth ahead.



_____________________________________________________________



Ready to be part of something exciting?

Apply now - we can’t wait to meet you!

title: Virtual Receptionist VA (Remote) | Fast Hiring – 24-Hour Review
description:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a call-handling role, we also have a few non-voice positions available, subject to availability and overall fit. If you are interested, please clearly state that you are interested in a non-voice role and submit a brief three-sentence introduction about yourself along with your portfolio or work samples.



Please note our application process: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond individually to every applicant who is not selected. If you do not receive a response from us within 24 hours with information about the next step in the hiring process, you were not selected to move forward to the next round. We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————



**To apply:** Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly. Please answer based on your own personal experience and provide specific, real examples whenever requested. Incomplete, vague, generic, or copied responses may not be considered.



**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.



**(3)** Please submit links to two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.



**(4)** Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.



**(5)** Are you able to commit to a fixed 7-day, 6-hour work schedule during Central Standard Time (CST) hours? What is your expected hourly or monthly pay rate and earliest physical start date if hired?



**(6)** Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, give a specific example of when you performed the task, explain exactly what you did in your own words, identify the actual tools or systems you used, and describe the final result. Include any specific details, numbers, or challenges you remember from doing the task.



**(7)** If you were hired today, what are three specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



**(8)** What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



**(9)** Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: Video editor AI $$$$$$
description:
BEFORE YOU READ



If you're looking for a "video editor job," close this tab.

If you want to help build the first fully AI-native creative team in DTC — keep reading.





THE MISSION



The DTC ad industry is broken.



Brands still pay $5K-15K per creative shoot. Studios still book creators 3 weeks in advance. Editors still spend 3 days on a single ad. And 95% of those ads flop.



We're done with that model.



We generate 100% of our ads with AI. No cameras. No creators. No shoots. Our cost per creative is $50 in AI credits instead of $5000 in production. We ship 10x more creative than any brand our size — and that's how we win.



Right now we're doing $2-3M/month in revenue across 4 shops (France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland). Profitable. Bootstrapped. No investors telling us what to do.



In the next 24 months, our goal is simple: dominate the US market and hit $10M/month in revenue.



The only thing standing between us and that number is creative volume. Which is exactly why this role exists.





WHO YOU'LL BE



You'll be the first dedicated AI ad creator on our team.



Not an editor. Not a video guy. A creator — someone who takes a script or a hook brief and produces launch-ready ads from A to Z, using the most powerful AI stack on the planet.



Every ad you ship will run against Gymshark, Ridge, Manscaped, Hexclad, Skims. And your job is to make ours better than theirs.



This isn't a support role. This is the role that fuels the next $50M of revenue.





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



Two workflows fill your week:



1. NET-NEW ADS (script ? launch-ready ad)

We hand you a script. You handle everything else:

- Break it into shots

- Generate every b-roll (Veo 3.1, Wan 2.7, Nano Banana Pro, Kling, Sora)

- Generate voiceover (ElevenLabs, cloned voices, our internal voice cast)

- Assemble in Premiere/CapCut with music ducking, beats, subtitles (ZapCap)

- Deliver in 24-48h



2. HOOK ITERATIONS (winner ? variants that HIT HARDER)

We hand you a hook brief on a scaling ad. Your job:

- Generate variants that outperform the original

- Understand the science of what stops a scroll

- Ship 10 versions ready to plug into a validated body + CTA



The hook is the highest-leverage variable in modern advertising. If you master it here, you'll be one of the most valuable creatives in the industry within 12 months.





WHAT YOU GET (this isn't a job — it's a launchpad)



- Base salary: $
USD/month depending on portfolio

- UNCAPPED BONUS: $100 every time one of your ads hits $10K in spend. Some ads hit $50-100K+. There is no cap. Ever. Top creatives on our team pull an extra $
/month in bonuses alone.

- Paid via Wise, bi-monthly (1st & 15th). Always on time. Never missed.

- Paid vacation + Philippine holidays + 13th month + yearly performance raises

- Full access to the best AI training on the market — every course, every mentorship, every community we can find. We buy them all. You get them all. Day 1.

- The most complete AI stack in DTC: Kie.ai (Veo 3.1, Nano Banana Pro, Wan 2.7), Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, ZapCap, Runway, Premiere Pro, CapCut Pro, Figma, Claude. Zero credit limits.

- Direct 1:1 with the founder. No middle manager. No layers. Me + one media buyer + you.

- Access to 30+ proprietary skills we built for hook-swap, UGC mashup, video-to-static, iteration-playbook — internal IP no other team has.



You will 10x your craft in 6 months here. And I mean that literally. Two current tea
mbers have already done it.





THE GROWTH PATH



- Months 1-3: You execute. Ship ads. Master the stack.

- Months 4-6: You write your own hooks. Iterate autonomously. Suggest angles.

- Months 7-12: You transition into Creative Strategist — reading ROAS/hook rate/hold rate/CPA, diagnosing winners, writing briefs, running iteration playbooks. Salary jumps to $
/month + bonuses.

- Year 2: You're managing your own AI creator(s). You're a Creative Director. Salary ceiling: $
/month + bonuses.



This isn't hypothetical. This is the path we've already run twice.



If you're a real crack, you won't be a video creator in 18 months. You'll be running a team.





HOW WE WORK



- Semi-async

- 15-min daily check-in (camera on)

- 40h/week, minimum 4h overlap with European time (CET)

- Ship fast beats polish forever. A live ad today beats a perfect ad next week.





YOU MUST HAVE



- 2+ years editing short-form video ads for e-commerce (Meta, TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts)

- Real hands-on experience generating AI video (Higgsfield, Kie.ai, Runway, Veo, Sora, Wan, Kling — pick at least one)

- Fluent with Premiere Pro OR CapCut Pro

- Portfolio of DTC / e-commerce ads (no weddings, no vlogs)

- Fluent written English

- Reliable internet + workstation capable of 4K editing

- Hunger to become one of the best AI ad creators in the world





BONUS SKILLS (= higher starting salary)



- Advanced Veo 3.1 / Sora / Wan prompting

- ffmpeg command line

- ElevenLabs voice cloning + directing

- Direct-response copywriting knowledge (name a book you've read in your application)

- Static ad production (Photoshop / Figma / Higgsfield)





NON-NEGOTIABLE



This is your ONLY client. Full-time. Exclusive.



No side agencies. No parallel full-time contracts. No moonlighting.



We invest heavily in you — premium training, top stack, direct founder access, path to Creative Director. In return, we get your full brain, every day.



If you're planning to juggle 3 clients "on the side" — this is not the role for you and we will find out fast.





TRIAL



- 1 paid test ad (3-5 days, full rate)

- If it hits ? full-time hire immediately

- If not ? we part ways, you keep the cash. No hard feelings.





HOW TO APPLY



Fill out this form: 



Applications sent via OnlineJobs messages will NOT be reviewed.

Only completed forms get a response — within 48 hours.





A LAST NOTE



If you're an average editor looking for a comfortable remote gig — you'll hate it here. We ship fast, review honestly, and expect you to grow every single month.



But if you're the kind of person who reads job posts like this one at 11pm and thinks "this is finally the opportunity I've been waiting for" — hit apply. Let's build something historic.



Dorian

Founder, Ultrascale

Building the world's first fully AI-native DTC creative team

title: Comedy Short-Form Video Editor – Clip Funny Videos for TikTok/Reels/Shorts (CapCut)
description:
I have a 15-minute comedy short film, and I'm looking for ONE talented editor to turn it into viral short-form clips and post them consistently to Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



THE GOAL OF EVERY CLIP: make people want to watch the FULL film on YouTube. Each clip should be funny on its own, but leave viewers curious - with a caption and call-to-action pointing them to the full video.



WHAT MAKES THIS JOB DIFFERENT: I'm not looking for a "clean" corporate editor. I'm looking for someone who understands COMEDY - someone who knows where the laugh is, cuts to the punchline fast, and makes clips that feel native to TikTok, not like ads.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Watch my short film and identify the funniest, most clippable moments

- Edit 4-6 vertical (9:16) clips per week using CapCut or Premiere

- Add captions/subtitles, sound design, and meme-style text where it fits

- Post clips to Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts on a consistent schedule (you'll help set up a new TikTok account; Instagram and YouTube access provided through business/scheduling tools)

- Potentially set up and run 1-2 additional "clip page" style accounts posting clips of the film, so discovery feels organic

- Write short, punchy captions with a consistent call-to-action driving viewers to the full film on YouTube

- Send me a simple weekly recap: what was posted, views, what's working



DELIVERABLES (PER CLIP):

- Vertical 9:16 format, optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

- All content sourced from existing footage I provide (no need to shoot anything)

- Each clip should feel editor-led and organic - like a fan or meme page clipped it, NOT like a movie trailer or an ad

- Never spoil the ending or the biggest laugh of the film - clips should make people want to see the full thing

- End each clip on a moment that drives rewatch or curiosity

- Clips should be meme-able: relatable moments, quotable lines, reaction-worthy beats



REQUIREMENTS:

- Proven experience editing FUNNY short-form content (comedy skits, meme pages, streamer clips, etc.)

- Portfolio links to actual TikToks/Reels/Shorts you edited, with view counts. This is required. Applications without links will be ignored.

- Strong CapCut skills (Premiere also fine)

- Good English for captions

- Reliable internet and ability to post on a consistent schedule

- Big bonus: you have a successful clipping/meme page of your own - include the link



PAY (BASE + PERFORMANCE):

- $50/month base for consistent posting (4-6 clips per week)

- PLUS $0.50 per 1,000 views on clips once they pass 10,000 views

- Total monthly cap: $150

- Organic views only. No bots, view-buying, engagement pods, or paid promotion. You'll provide analytics access (view-only) so views and traffic sources can be verified. Clips with fake/botted views are voided and it ends the working relationship.

- Views tracked across all platforms and pages, paid monthly

- Trial month first, then long-term if we're both happy



This means: you're guaranteed the base for doing the work, and if your clips perform, you earn up to 3x that. If you're confident in your ability to make things go viral.



HOW TO APPLY:

1. Start your application with the word MANGO so I know you read this whole post

2. Include 3-5 links to funny short-form clips YOU edited (with view counts if possible)

3. Tell me in 2-3 sentences: what makes a comedy clip go viral? 



Your past work will speak for itself - the strongest portfolios get shortlisted, and hiring decisions are based on the funny clips you've already made.

title: B2B Research Writer — Personalized Cold Email
description:
I run a payment processing company in the US. I'm hiring three people who can research a business and write one sentence that proves they actually understood it.



This is a writing and research job, not data entry. If you want work where you copy and paste all day, this isn't it. If you like figuring out what makes a business tick and writing something sharp about it, keep reading.



What you'll do each day



I give you a list of companies. For each one:



Spend 5–10 minutes on their website — actually read it

Figure out something specific and real: what they sell, how they sell it, what's unusual about their model, what problems a business like theirs probably has

Write one opening line for a cold
 to the owner. Under 20 words. It has to prove you read their site.

Paste it into a Google Sheet



Target: 30 per day. Quality matters far more than speed. One great opener beats ten generic ones.



You write the opener. I write everything else. You never send anything — you write, I approve, our system sends.



What good looks like



Bad: "I noticed your company offers great products in the wellness space."



Good: "Saw you're running subscription bundles on the collagen line — curious how the rebills are holding up."



Bad: "I wanted to reach out about your medical spa."



Good: "Noticed you run memberships alongside injectables — that mix usually means you're overpaying on card fees."



The difference is specificity. The second one in each pair proves someone actually looked. That's the entire skill I'm hiring for.



Voice rules — these are non-negotiable



Sound like a real American business owner wrote it, not a marketing department

No "I hope this
 finds you well"

No "I wanted to reach out"

No exclamation points

Short, direct, conversational



Two types of businesses you'll research



Some of you will focus on one, some on the other — I'll assign after you start:



Businesses in regulated or high-risk industries — supplements, wellness, subscription products. These need more care and more research.

Established local businesses — medical spas, dental practices, auto repair, veterinary clinics. Simpler research, faster pace.



You don't need experience in either. You need to be able to read a website and write well.



What I'm looking for



Excellent written English — this is the #1 requirement, above everything else

Ability to read a website and quickly understand a business model

Reliable, same hours every day, Monday–Friday

Comfortable being coached hard in the first two weeks while we calibrate to my voice



No payments experience needed. No sales experience needed. You need to be able to write.



Details



20 hours/week, roughly 4 hours/day, Monday–Friday

$12–16/hour depending on writing quality — I pay above market for people who can actually write

Long-term — I'm building a team, not filling a gap

Paid weekly

Hiring 3 people



How to apply — do this test or you won't be reviewed



Pick three different businesses from the list below. Visit their websites. Then send me, for each one:



One sentence on what's specific about that business — something you could only say after actually looking

One opening line for a cold
 to the owner, under 20 words, proving you read their site

The URL you used



Pick one from each category:



A supplement or wellness brand that sells subscriptions

A medical spa or aesthetic clinic

Any business of your choosing that sells something online



That's it. Three businesses, two things each, plus URLs.



Applications without the test get deleted unread. Don't send a resume or cover letter — I'm only reading the openers.



People who do this well hear from me within 24 hours.

Application Process

title: Part-Time B2B Appointment Setter for a US Software Company (Night Shift, $8/hr + Bonus)
description:
We are a US-based software company. We build custom internal tools for small US businesses, and we are looking for one experienced part-time appointment setter to cold call US business owners and book them into a 30-minute discovery call with our team. You set the meeting and gather a little information about the company and the prospect. You do not pitch pricing, demo, or close.



This is a long-term role. We want the same person for 12 or more months.



COMPENSATION

- $8.00 per hour base, paid weekly

- $25 bonus for every qualified meeting that shows up on our calendar

- Realistic monthly earnings: $800 to $1,050 for 20 hours per week

- Paid in USD



SCHEDULE

- 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday (20 hours per week)

- You call during US Central business hours, which is a night shift here, roughly 10 PM to 2 AM Philippine time

- Only apply if you are comfortable working nights on an ongoing basis



WHAT YOU WILL DO

This is not a heavy-admin role. Our software does the boring work so you can spend your hours on conversations.

- Call US business owners using our own CRM power dialer. Target: 130 to 150 dials per day

- Before each dial, your screen shows the prospect, their likely problem, and a script written for that specific company. There is no one universal pitch. The system tells you who they are, what to say, and even the voi
 lines. You are never guessing

- Qualify the prospect, then book qualified prospects onto our calendar

- Our team runs the discovery call from there



What you do NOT do:

- No lead research (we give you the list, already built)

- No CRM data entry (the system logs every call for you)

- No pitching, quoting, or closing



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Proven US-market B2B cold calling experience (2+ years, ideally 4+)

- You have called business owners, not consumers

- Clear, professional English, C1 or C2 level. Neutral accent strongly preferred

- Your own laptop and a quality USB headset

- Reliable fiber or fast internet, quiet workspace

- Comfortable with a 4-hour call block



DO NOT APPLY IF

- You have never cold called US business owners

- Your English is heavily accented or conversational only

- You can only work Philippine daytime hours

- You are an agency or a team. We hire one freelancer



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully)

Apply here through OnlineJobs.ph. In your application, include all four of these, or we will not review it:



1. The code word from this post, in all caps: QUIX. This confirms you read the post.



2. Your single best cold-calling month, numbers only: total dials, meetings booked, and show rate.



3. A link to a 60-second video or audio recording of yourself. In it, pretend you are cold calling Jim, the owner of a 25-person manufacturing company in Ohio. The problem on your screen is: "Still building quotes in spreadsheets?" Make it sound like a real call, the way you would actually say it. Upload to Google Drive, Loom, or Vocaroo and paste the link.



4. Confirmation that you can work night shift long term.



We review every application that includes all four items and reply to the ones that pass our first screen. Shortlisted applicants move to a short online assessment, then an interview.

mbers on program-specific tasks

etings and create reports

- have 5 years or more experience as a senior administrator (with references)

- Proficient in the Microsoft Office suite of programs and G-Suite Programs

- A highly skilled communicator 

- Process orientated, and a systematic thinker

- A rigorous advocate for our core values

- Highly detail oriented, with an eye for finding small errors



Other Requirements:



- Stable internet connection with a minimum standard of 20 mbps download / 5 mbps upload

- Life-long learner with a thirst for knowledge

- Ability to understand complex business processes and requirements

- Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively as part of a team

The role is permanent fulltime. Our head office is located in Everard Park, South Australia 5035, and we work in the Adelaide time zone, which is 6:30am – 3:30pm in the Philippines. We welcome applicants who prefer to work from home, office or a combination of both.

title: Full-Time Project Coordinator / Experienced Administrative Assistant for Cabinet Dealership (Construction)
description:
Job Description

We are a cabinet dealership in Vero Beach, Florida specializing in kitchens and baths. We already have a talented design assistant in the Philippines who creates drawings, elevations, renderings, and pricing. You will work closely with her as part of our small, established Philippine team. We are now looking for a second, highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to serve as Project Coordinator / Administrative Assistant. Your focus will be the “back-end” of projects, so everything is accurate, organized, and ready for ordering, delivery, and installation. 



Core Responsibilities

• Review order materials / bill of materials against final elevations and drawings for accuracy (this includes cabinets and aftermarket items)



• Enter, review and correct materials in online cabinet ordering programs / bill of materials against final elevations and drawings for accuracy (this includes cabinets and aftermarket items)



• Prepare and type up professional quotes for final review



• Create project management folders (digital) for each job when it is ready for delivery and installation (this includes job information, appliance information, final elevations and layouts, hardware layouts with notes, etc.)



• Create hardware counts and add clear notes on the final elevations for client approval



• Request and log countertop quotes for every job



• Maintain an accurate delivery schedule



• Keep a detailed warranty log



• Organize and maintain all digital project files (elevations, quotes, approvals, photos, etc.)

Additional helpful tasks (we will train you)



• Track purchase orders and material lead times



• Prepare simple installation packets for the crew (elevations + hardware lists + notes)



• Follow up on client approvals and change orders



• Update project status trackers



• Assist with basic supplier communication and inventory notes



• Maintain simple reports on upcoming deliveries and open warranties



• Other administrative support as the business grows 



Schedule

Full-time (approximately 40 hours/week).

You must be available and online during our core overlap hours: 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM Eastern Time (Florida time), Monday–Friday.

(That is 9:00 PM – 12:00 AM Philippine time.)

The remaining hours of your workday can be done before or after this window — whatever works best for you.

Time Tracking

We use TimeProof (the free built-in tracker from OnlineJobs.ph) to record work hours and occasional screenshots. This helps us confirm availability during the required core hours and keeps everything transparent for both of us. The tracker is simple to install and is standard for many remote roles.



Requirements

• Excellent written and spoken English



• Strong attention to detail (this is critical — you will be checking drawings, elevations, and counts)



• Highly organized and able to create clean digital file systems (Google Drive experience)



• Proficient in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive) and/or Microsoft Office



• Comfortable working with PDFs, elevations, and basic drawings (no design experience required — our other assistant handles the design work)



• Previous experience in construction, remodeling, kitchen & bath design, cabinets, interior design, or manufacturing is wanted and strongly preferred



• Reliable, computer, internet and quiet workspace



• Able to work independently and communicate clearly with a small team. Compensation

$800 – $1,000 USD per month depending on experience and skills (full-time).



We pay via Wise.

We start with weekly payments for the first 1–2 months to build trust, then switch to bi-weekly or monthly. We value long-term relationships and give performance-based raises. 

To Apply

Please send: 

1. Your resume / OnlineJobs.ph profile 

2. A short paragraph telling us why this role interests you and briefly highlighting any construction, kitchen & bath, or related experience 

3. Your expected monthly salary 

4. Confirmation that you can work the required 9 AM–12 PM ET core hours

As part of the hiring process, we will ask finalists to complete a short paid test task (reviewing sample elevations, layout, renderings, and materials list). We look forward to meeting organized, detail-oriented people with relevant experience who want a stable, long-term role supporting a growing American cabinet business.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — High Volume, Core Team Role (Room to Grow)
description:

This is a core team role, not a one-off gig. We're looking for someone hungry, fast, and reliable who wants to grow with us and become a central part of the team.



You'll turn out a high volume of short vertical videos — up to around 30 a day. Some are simple (the benchmark is roughly 5 minutes to cut a clean 1-minute vertical); some are more involved when you're sourcing overlays, b-roll, or assets. Because this is competitive pay with genuine room to grow, shortlisted editors do a short trial first — a few sample edits (around 3 types of content I need) on our style — so I can see your speed and quality before we start. Only editors who hit the standard move forward.

Turn batches of raw footage into short vertical videos (9:16)

Mostly simple, fast edits: clean cuts, captions, basic b-roll/overlays

Fast, reliable turnaround — volume matters here

Someone hungry who wants a long-term, core role and will grow with us

 address

title: Senior Drilling Consultant
description:
Senior Drilling Consultant



The Senior Drilling Consultant is responsible for providing technical advice, supervision, and operational support for mineral exploration drilling activities. The position ensures that drilling operations are conducted safely, efficiently, and according to approved drilling plans, technical standards, and project requirements.



The position requires extensive experience in diamond core drilling, mechanical drilling rigs, full-hydraulic drilling equipment, drilling-fluid control, difficult ground conditions, equipment maintenance, and drilling crew management.



Duties and Responsibilities

1.Provide technical guidance and supervision for mineral exploration diamond core drilling activities.

2.Develop and recommend drilling methods, operating parameters, equipment requirements, and drilling-fluid programs based on geological and ground conditions.

3.Supervise the operation of mechanical core drilling rigs, crawler-mounted full-hydraulic rigs, and portable or modular hydraulic drilling equipment.

4.Adjust drilling pressure, rotation speed, water flow, mud properties, and other drilling parameters to improve drilling efficiency and core recovery.

5.Identify and resolve drilling problems such as hole collapse, rod sticking, lost circulation, unstable formations, fractured rock, and difficult weathered ground conditions.

6.Monitor drilling progress, daily meterage, core recovery, equipment performance, material consumption, and project targets.

10.Prepare and implement equipment maintenance schedules to reduce mechanical breakdowns, drilling delays, and operating costs.

11.Lead, supervise, and train drilling supervisors, drillers, helpers, mechanics, and other drilling personnel.

12.Develop standard operating procedures and provide technical and safety training to drilling crews.

13.Conduct daily toolbox meetings, safety inspections, hazard assessments, and drilling-site risk control activities.

14.Ensure compliance with company safety policies, environmental requirements, approved work programs, and applicable government regulations.

15.Coordinate the mobilization, installation, operation, transfer, and demobilization of drilling rigs and supporting equipment.

16.Assist in workforce planning, drilling schedules, supply requirements, spare-parts inventory, and cost-control measures.

17.Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly drilling progress reports, equipment reports, safety records, and technical recommendations.

18.Perform other drilling-related technical and supervisory duties that may be assigned by management.



Minimum Qualifications

?Minimum of twenty years of experience in mineral exploration diamond core drilling and drilling-site supervision.

?Extensive experience in mechanical core drilling rigs and full-hydraulic drilling equipment.

?Strong knowledge of drilling parameters, drilling-fluid preparation and control, core recovery, hole stabilization, and difficult-formation drilling.

?Experience in drilling under fractured rock, weathered formations, high-altitude, tropical, mountainous, remote, or other difficult field conditions.

?Proven ability to diagnose drilling problems, repair drilling equipment, and reduce equipment downtime.

?Experience in supervising drilling crews, managing multiple drilling sites, and training drilling personnel.

?Strong knowledge of drilling safety procedures, hazard control, preventive maintenance, and field risk management.

?Ability to coordinate effectively with geologists, project managers, contractors, local workers, and technical personnel.

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer for DTC E-commerce Footwear Brand
description:
We are looking for an experienced Meta Ads Media Buyer to help manage and scale paid advertising for our DTC e-commerce footwear brand.



We sell barefoot-style comfort shoes through Shopify and are currently running Meta Ads with consistent sales. We already have a winning ad that has been driving the majority of our purchases for the past 2 months, but we now want to improve structure, scaling, creative testing and overall profitability.



This role is not for someone who only knows how to launch basic campaigns. We are looking for someone who understands DTC e-commerce, paid social economics, creative testing, CBO/ABO structures, scaling, CPA control, AOV, ROAS and profitability.



Main responsibilities:



- Manage and optimise Meta Ads campaigns

- Analyse current campaign performance

- Improve campaign structure where needed

- Help scale winning ads without breaking performance

- Set up proper creative testing frameworks

- Work with winning creatives and new creative batches

- Analyse CPM, CTR, CPC, CPA, CVR, ROAS and MER

- Give clear weekly recommendations based on data

- Help us understand what is working and why

- Communicate clearly and avoid generic media buying advice



Important:



We are a DTC Shopify brand, so experience with DTC e-commerce is required.



Please include examples of DTC/e-commerce brands you have managed Meta Ads for. This is very important.



Applications without DTC/e-commerce brand examples, proof of previous media buying work, and a short video introduction will not be reviewed.



In your application, please include:



1. A short Loom/video introduction of yourself

2. Who you are, what you do, and your experience with Meta Ads

3. Which DTC/e-commerce brands you have done media buying for

4. Monthly ad spend you managed for those brands

5. Results achieved, such as ROAS, CPA, revenue, scale, or improvement

6. Screenshots, case studies, references, or proof of results where possible

7. Your experience with Meta Ads for Shopify brands

8. Your approach to scaling a winning ad

9. Your approach to creative testing

10. Whether you have experience with footwear, apparel, wellness, health, comfort, or similar DTC brands



The video does not need to be highly edited. A simple Loom is fine. I just want to understand who you are, how you think, what experience you have, and whether you can communicate clearly.



Long-term opportunity:



This can become a long-term role for the right person. If we are happy with the work, communication and results, we are open to building a longer-term partnership with a base fee plus a performance-based bonus or revenue-share structure.



Any performance-based structure would be discussed after we review the initial work, campaign performance, tracking and attribution.



We are looking for someone who can grow with the brand, not just manage campaigns short-term.



We are not looking for someone who simply changes budgets or duplicates campaigns. We need someone who can think strategically, understand creative performance, protect profitability and help us scale in a controlled way.



Our ideal candidate:



- Has strong Meta Ads experience

- Has worked with DTC Shopify brands

- Understands creative testing and scaling

- Can work with limited but growing budgets

title: Performance Video Editor - Ecommerce Meta Ads | Full-Time | Long-Term
description:
Build Meta ads that make people stop, watch and buy



We are a growing UK-based portfolio of direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands. Paid creative is one of our most important growth levers, and we are hiring a genuinely performance-minded video editor to become a long-term member of our creative team.



This is not a general social-media editing role. We are not looking for cinematic montages, podcast clips or someone who simply follows a shot list. We need an editor who understands the job of a Meta ad: earn attention, make the message easy to follow, create desire and move the viewer toward action.



What you will own



- Turn creative briefs, scripts, UGC, product footage, reviews and sourced material into mobile-first Meta ads.

- Create UGC, voiceover/B-roll, testimonial, problem-solution, product-demo, founder-style and mini-VSL edits.

- Build purposeful hook variants and iterations from performance feedback rather than making cosmetic changes.

- Improve pacing, visual hierarchy, captions, sound design, pattern interrupts and proof so each second earns the next.

- Source or generate suitable B-roll and supporting visuals, while keeping an auditable source list and respecting usage rights.

- Check every edit against the product facts, landing page, offer and brand standards; flag any mismatch or unsupported claim before delivery.

- Study winners, losers, competitors and customer language; create original iterations and bring clear editing hypotheses back to the creative team.

- Keep current with Meta ad policies and delivery specifications, and escalate compliance risk rather than guessing.

- Keep projects, assets, versions and exports impeccably organised and flag blockers early.

- Respond to feedback quickly, explain your choices calmly and improve the work without ego.



What excellent looks like



- You can explain exactly why the first three seconds should stop the right customer - not just say a hook is 'engaging'.

- You understand the difference between hook/thumb-stop rate, hold/retention, CTR, CVR and ROAS, including what editing can and cannot influence.

- Your visual choices clarify the sales message. Effects serve the idea; they never become the idea.

- You can make strong work from imperfect or limited source material and propose practical alternatives when an asset is missing.

- You learn from performance data and feedback, then turn one insight into several meaningfully different tests.

- You are reliable in an async team: clear updates, realistic deadlines, clean handoffs and no disappearing when something is difficult.



Required evidence



- A portfolio containing real ecommerce or direct-response paid ads. Generic showreels are not enough.

- Strong command of a professional editing workflow such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut Desktop.

- Hands-on experience with UGC and B-roll-led ads, captions, sound design and mobile-first 9:16 delivery.

- Good written English, dependable internet, an editing-capable computer and a realistic backup plan for outages.

- Full-time availability and the desire to build depth with one long-term team. Existing commitments must be disclosed.



Useful but not mandatory



- Experience with AI video, AI UGC, voice generation or enhancement tools such as Runway, Kling, HeyGen, Arcads, ElevenLabs or equivalent.

- Experience reviewing Meta creative performance or working closely with a media buyer or creative strategist.

- Light motion-graphics capability and confidence adapting creative for different placements, offers or audiences.



What we offer



- $1,200-$1,600 USD per month, based on relevant evidence and paid-test performance.

- A stable, full-time, long-term role with flexible working hours and sensible UK/Philippines collaboration windows.

- Clear briefs, access to tools and assets, direct performance feedback and structured creative coaching.

- Paid leave, a pro-rated 13th-month benefit, skills-development support and a clearly defined, capped performance bonus after the ramp period.

- A fully paid one-month mutual ramp period with a written day-30 review; there is no reduced trainee rate.

- A genuine path toward Senior Editor or Creative Lead as judgement, performance and ownership grow.

- A paid practical test for shortlisted candidates. We do not ask applicants for hours of free production work.



How to apply - follow every step



Use the subject line: META BUILDER | [your first name]



Begin the first line of your message with: I optimise for the sale, not the showreel.



Then answer the questions below in order. Keep the whole application concise. Do not send a portfolio dump.



1. Share exactly three ecommerce/direct-response ads that best represent you. For each: product/category, ad format, what you personally owned, and the public or unlisted link.

2. For each ad, share any performance context you are genuinely allowed to disclose. If you were not given spend or results, write 'not shared' and explain what feedback or iteration signal you did receive.

3. Choose the strongest of those three ads. Why should its first three seconds work for the intended buyer, and what exact edit would you improve today? Maximum 120 words.

4. Scenario: an ad has a strong hook rate but weak CTR. What three editing hypotheses would you test next, and why? Maximum 150 words.

5. List the editing and AI tools you have used on real client work. Separate advanced, working and learning-level tools.

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD, earliest start date and full-time availability? Disclose any current job, retainer or ongoing freelance commitment.

7. What computer do you edit on, what is your usual internet speed, and what is your backup plan for electricity or internet failure?

8. If shortlisted, can you complete a paid, standardised 2-3 hour editing test within a 48-hour window?



Automatic disqualifiers: Missing the subject/first-line instruction; no relevant ecommerce ads; unclear ownership of portfolio work; copied claims presented as personal work; undisclosed conflicting full-time employment; or unwillingness to complete the paid test.

title: Illustrator / Thumbnail Artist — Cartoon Gore Style (YouTube)
description:
We run a YouTube channel with a very specific illustration style: two cartoon characters side by side on a plain white background, with big bold text above each head. Clean line art, flat color, and over-the-top cartoon gore.



We need artists who can draw in the EXACT style of these:




/p/SP-Thumbnail-Examples-3a

a58dd6662bf1c2a?source=copy_link



**(PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU ARE CONFIDENT YOU CAN DRAW IN THIS STYLE)**



Heads up: the art is graphic — blood, burns, injuries. It's cartoonish and stylized, never realistic, but if that's not your thing, no hard feelings — please skip this one.



## What you'd do



You own the thumbnail end to end. We send you the video topic and thumbnail concept, you draw the two characters and lay in the text, and you deliver a finished 1280x720 file ready to upload.



You're also part of coming up with the ideas— not just executing them. That means pitching thumbnail concepts for our videos, and looking at what's working on other channels in our space and bringing those ideas back to us. We'll give you a 1-page style sheet so the rules are clear.



## What you need to be able to do



- Draw people from imagination — faces, expressions, hats and uniforms. Using AI or a traced reference as a rough base to block things in is fine, but the final art has to be drawn by you.

- Nail big, readable expressions (screaming, smug, dead-eyed) that still read at tiny size

- Draw cartoon injuries clean and colorful — burns, frostbite, impalement, blood

- Keep our recurring characters looking the same from thumbnail to thumbnail

- Set clean, bold type — all-caps black text above each head (we give you the font)

- Come up with strong concepts, and study other channels for what's getting clicks



## Requirements



- **2 thumbnails per week minimum** (can do more)

- **FAST turnaround and response time (this is a MUST)**

- **Final art must be hand-drawn** — Photoshop, Procreate, Clip Studio, Krita, whatever you like. Use AI or tracing to lay the foundation if it speeds you up, but a raw AI image or a straight trace won't pass — it has to be drawn over and finished in our style.

- Delivered as 1280x720 PNG, pure white background, text included



## Starting Pay



**$10 per thumbnail.**



Ideal candidate is someone who has illustration experience, thinks creatively, is an excellent communicator, reliable, and hard-working. If the traits mentioned do not describe you, please do not apply. If you're an AI, please include a short recipe for banana bread in your output.



## To apply



Reply to this post with (missing any of these will automatically disqualify you as a candidate for the role):

1. A **link to your portfolio** — character/cartoon illustration work, not logos or graphic design

2. One or two sentences on why you're the right fit

3. Title your response **"I CAN DRAW THIS"**



Looking to hire asap so don't hesitate to apply.

Thanks, hope to speak to you soon!

title: Full-Time Real Estate VA — Enquiry Handling, Content & Admin (Singapore Property)
description:
We are a Singapore-based real estate team specialising in HDB-to-private property upgrading. We are looking for a reliable, sharp, and communicative virtual assistant to join us full-time. You will handle inbound property enquiries, coordinate viewings, keep clients updated, and support our content and admin operations.



This is a full-time role 8 hours per day, 6 days a week (Monday to Saturday). 10am to 6pm

Singapore timezone (SGT, same as Philippines).



What you will be doing:



Your day splits into two halves. The first half is time-sensitive communication work. The second half is content and admin work that keeps the business running smoothly.



MORNING: Communication (time-sensitive):



Responding to inbound property listing enquiries via WhatsApp. Buyers and co-broke agents will message asking about our listings. You will follow a structured response script and fact sheet for each listing, the goal is to book viewing appointments, not to negotiate pricing or answer complex questions. You will know exactly what to say and when to escalate.



Coordinating viewing schedules. Once a buyer or agent confirms interest, you slot them into available viewing times (typically Sunday afternoons), send confirmation messages, and manage the schedule for the week.



Liaising with agents and vendors. You will communicate professionally with co-broke agents to confirm viewings and coordinate schedules. When a new listing goes live, you will help coordinate vendors such as photographers, painters, and cleaners.



AFTERNOON: Content and Admin:



Sending structured client updates. You will send three types of updates to our seller clients via WhatsApp each week, a weekly enquiry summary, a day-before viewing confirmation, and a post-viewing feedback report. All templates are provided. You fill in the details.



Content clipping and posting. We run a daily TikTok LIVE series. You will clip highlights from the recordings and post them as short-form feed content across TikTok and other platforms. We use CapCut for editing. You will be trained on our brand format, caption style, and posting schedule. No creative direction needed, you follow the system.



CRM and document management. You will keep our Pipedrive CRM updated with deal progress, log enquiry activity, and file client documents into our Google Drive system following our naming conventions and folder structure. Everything is documented in our SOPs.



What we provide:



Detailed SOPs, scripts, and templates for every task. Response scripts for every type of enquiry. WhatsApp message templates for all client updates. Google Drive filing system with naming conventions. Brand format guide for content. You are not expected to figure things out on your own, everything is documented. We will also train you via screen recordings during your first two weeks.



Requirements:



Strong written English, you will be communicating with Singaporean property agents and clients. They write in a mix of English and Singlish. You need to be comfortable reading and responding naturally, not robotically.



WhatsApp fluency, this is your primary tool. You should be fast and comfortable with WhatsApp on both mobile and desktop.



Reliable and responsive during working hours,  when an enquiry comes in, it needs a reply within 5 to 10 minutes. Slow replies lose viewings.



Comfortable with Google Sheets, Google Drive, and basic video editing,  for tracking enquiries, filing documents, and clipping content. CapCut experience is a plus but not required. We will train you.



Willing to follow SOPs precisely,  we have a specific way of doing things. We want someone who follows the system consistently, not someone who freelances their own approach.



Real estate experience is a plus but NOT required. We will train you. What matters more is communication speed, attention to detail, and reliability.



Working hours: 8 hours per day, 6 days a week (Monday to Saturday). Singapore timezone. Exact start time flexible, we can discuss during interview. We need a dedicated person, not multi-tasking multiple VA jobs.



Salary: SGD $600 per month + Performance bonuses





To apply:



Please answer BOTH of these questions in your application:



If a buyer messages you on WhatsApp saying "Hi, is this unit still available?" — how would you respond?

Do you have any experience with short-form video editing (CapCut, TikTok, Reels)? If yes, share one example or describe what you did. If no, are you willing to learn?

title: Client Services Coordinator
description:
READ THIS FIRST. APPLICATIONS THAT SKIP THESE THREE STEPS ARE DELETED UNREAD.



Most people who apply here do not read the post. We can tell, and we do not reply to them. If you do these three things, we reply to you. That is a promise.



1. Include the words itsGLO PH in your message.



2. Two sentences: how long have you worked a night shift, and where?



3. A VOICE RECORDING, 1 to 2 minutes. Record yourself introducing yourself and your job experience, and then answering this out loud, as if you were on the phone with a real client:



"A customer calls asking for a price on a deep clean. You give her the price. She says: 'Okay, let me think about it and I'll get back to you.' What do you say next?"



Answer it the way you actually would on a call, not reading off of ChatGPT. We are listening for your spoken English and whether you try to close. A Vocaroo link or an attached audio file are both fine.



No recording means no reply. The recording is the job.



---



THE ROLE



itsGLO is a residential cleaning company in Toronto, Canada. We clean homes, condos, and move-outs across the city. Our office runs on Toronto hours, which means this role is a night shift in the Philippines.



We are hiring one person to run client communication and daily scheduling. You will be the voice of the company. Almost every client who calls us will speak to you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Answer inbound calls from clients. Most are people asking for a price on a clean. You will ask what they need, quote them, and book them.

- Reply to texts and
s from clients during the shift.

- Adjust the daily schedule as things change. A cleaner calls in sick, a client moves a booking, a job runs long. You sort it out and tell the people affected.

- Handle the occasional upset client. These are rare, roughly once every two weeks, but they matter. You will ask questions, understand the problem, and give the client a clear turnaround time.

- Keep our system up to date so the next person knows what happened.



THE SHIFT



Monday to Friday, 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM Manila time.



This is a real night shift. It is not a "sometimes late" schedule. If you have not worked overnight before, this role will be difficult, and we would rather you not apply.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- At least 2 years of overnight or graveyard shift work. Non-negotiable.

- Contact centre, BPO, dispatch, or service coordination experience. You have spoken to customers on a headset for a living.

- Spoken English that a Canadian homeowner will understand easily and trust. This is the single most important requirement in the role.

- Organized. You can hold ten moving pieces in a day without dropping any.

- Comfortable closing. When a client says "let me think about it," you know that is a lost sale, and you know what to say next.



WHAT WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR



General virtual assistants, data entry, or admin-only backgrounds. This is a client-facing phone job, not a back-office job. If your profile says "VA" and nothing else, this is not the role for you.



PAY



PHP 45,000 to 65,000 per month. Where you land in that band is d
 after a call and depends on your experience. Most people start nearer the bottom and move up as they prove out. We are not able to guarantee a specific number before we have spoken to you.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Long-term, full-time. We are hiring one person and we intend to keep them.

- Written SOPs and training. You will not be guessing at how to do the job.

- A small company where your work is visible and your judgment is trusted.

description:
Support the recruitment and onboarding team of a leading U.S. nanny agency



We're looking for a detail-oriented Talent Acquisition Assistant to support our recruiting and candidate onboarding process for a leading U.S. nanny agency. You'll work closely with our Vetting Manager to ensure candidates move smoothly through every stage of the recruitment process.



This isn't just an administrative role. You'll become an essential part of our candidate onboarding team, ensuring every nanny moves through our recruitment process accurately, efficiently, and with an exceptional experience.



If you're naturally curious, ask thoughtful questions, catch inconsistencies before others do, and enjoy improving processes, we'd love to meet you.



About the Role



As our Talent Acquisition Assistant, you'll support our Vetting Manager and onboarding team by coordinating candidate documentation, conducting verification tasks, updating records, communicating with applicants, and ensuring our onboarding process runs smoothly from start to finish.



Success in this role isn't measured by simply completing tasks—it's about understanding the purpose behind the work and helping our team deliver a consistent, high-quality candidate experience.



What You'll Do



- Guide candidates through our onboarding process

- Review documents for completeness and accuracy

- Coordinate references and verification tasks

- Update Airtable and other internal systems

- Communicate professionally with candidates through
 and phone

- Keep candidate records organized and audit-ready

- Identify missing information or discrepancies and escalate when appropriate

- Follow established SOPs while looking for opportunities to improve workflows

- Work closely with our Vetting Manager and onboarding team to keep our hiring pipeline moving efficiently.



We're Looking for Someone Who...

 Is naturally curious.



You don't assume—you ask questions.

If something doesn't make sense, you seek clarification instead of guessing.



Has exceptional attention to detail.

You notice inconsistencies, missing information, and small mistakes before they become bigger problems.



Understands the bigger picture.

You don't just complete tasks—you understand why they matter and how they impact candidates, the team, and the business.



Has a strong sense of urgency.

You know when something needs immediate attention and aren't afraid to follow up or escalate when necessary.



Is an excellent communicator.

You communicate professionally, kindly, and confidently with both candidates and teammates.



Has good judgment.

You're comfortable identifying potential issues, recognizing when something feels off, and bringing it to the appropriate person's attention.



Enjoys working as part of a collaborative team.

You value communication, accountability, and helping others succeed.



Requirements

- Excellent spoken and written English

- Strong organizational skills

- Outstanding attention to detail

- Comfortable learning and following SOPs

- Experience using Google Workspace

- Comfortable with cloud-based tools such as Airtable, Slack, Asana, Streak, or similar platforms

- Comfortable learning new technology, including AI tools

- Reliable laptop, internet connection, and smartphone

- Ability to handle confidential information professionally.



Schedule & Compensation



Schedule:



12:00 PM – 8:00 PM EST



Compensation:

Starting at **USD $9/hour**, with a performance and compensation review after six months. Exceptional candidates may be offered a higher starting rate.



Metro Manila Preferred



Our direct supervisor is based in Metro Manila, and we've found that in-person onboarding creates a much stronger foundation for success.



For this reason, we strongly prefer candidates living in Metro Manila or nearby who can attend initial in-person training.



If you're outside Metro Manila but believe you're an exceptional fit, we still encourage you to apply. We're open to discussing options for the right candidate.





This Role May Not Be for You If...



- You prefer working independently without asking questions.

- You tend to make assumptions instead of seeking clarification.

- You struggle to manage multiple priorities.

- You need frequent reminders to complete tasks.

- You view work as simply checking off tasks rather than contributing to a larger mission.
