title: Part-Time Social Media Manager & Operations Assistant
description:
Building Bosses is a UK-based property network that teaches entrepreneurs and aspiring business owners how to invest in property. We are looking for a long-term, trusted, and diligent remote social media & operations manager to join our growing team. This is a starting role with explicit scope to grow. This role has a clear pathway to scale into a full-time operations and community manager with increased compensation and responsibilities.



At Building Bosses, people are at the heart of what we do. We aim to build strong professional relationships and help each other to show up as our best selves every day while maintaining our top-performance ethos.

In this role, you will be at the core of our operations by managing our multi-platform social media presence and executing administrative tasks. Please note this position focuses on professional copywriting, admin, social media optimisation, and backend operations (video editing is not required however 2+ years experience in Social Media Management is mandatory).





Requirements



Fluent Written and Spoken English: Excellent grammar, spelling, and vocabulary, with the ability to write in a professional voice.

Independent Troubleshooting: Because we work in different time zones, real-time help is limited. You must be able to learn new software updates, and troubleshoot technical solutions independently before escalating to management for assistance.

Background: You must have 2+ years of remote assistant or social media management experience with UK-based clients. References will be required. Please ensure your university degree is listed on your resume. Advanced experience in google suite, notion, skool, instagram, tiktok and youtube is required.

Communication Standards: Communication is critical in this role. Because we operate across different time zones, you must maintain the following mandatory standards:

WhatsApp will be utilized as our primary tool for daily operational communication.

Acknowledge and respond to all messages and
s within 0-to-12-hours.

Be available to receive and join phone calls to handle urgent tasks.

A comprehensive report detailing tasks completed, tasks in progress, and any blockers must be submitted every week on a set day.





Core Weekly Tasks



1. Social Media Management - Planning, Publishing & Optimisation



Platforms: Posting to TikTok, Instagram Reels, Threads, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.

Copywriting: Draft clear, relevant, and value-driven captions that align with the brand's established voice and tone. The text should be easy to understand and organised using line breaks. 

All written copy must be human-authored; we utilize AI detection tools as part of our regular quality control. The submission of AI-generated work constitutes a breach of contract and may result in immediate termination.

Hashtags: Include 2-4 relevant hashtags at the end of the caption after 2 line breaks so they stay hidden behind the "See More" button. Avoid hashtags that could lead to account restriction. Also put hashtags and SEO keywords hidden off-screen for the algorithm.

Platform Tweaks: Manually pair TikTok/IG uploads with specific trending UK audio. Write catchy titles under 60 characters. Turn the video concept into a text post for LinkedIn.

Past Analysis & Calendar planning: Review our history of top-performing content to see which hooks, structures, and topics got the best results.

Hook Writing: For every video topic provided, write a few high-converting hook options to grab attention in the first 2 seconds, based on successful UK top performing accounts.

Trend Tracking: Spend 1 hour a week researching rising audio trends and competitor styles within the UK property and influencer space.

Ad-Hoc Operational Support: Assist with administrative logistics, basic script writing support, and event planning coordination as needed.



2. Skool Operations & Admin - Platform Building & Upkeep



Text Formatting: Move and re-format raw text from documents, google sheets and PDFs into Skool. Follow our formatting and spacing rules, use bold paragraph titles and always paste our mandatory copyright header at the top of every page.

Resource Embedding: Embed tools and documents into Skool using html  codes. The tools must be made non-downloadable so experience in creating non-downloadable files is mandatory.

Community Vetting: Check incoming member requests for our group daily. Only approve people who fully answer the entry questions. Flag spam accounts or incomplete profiles to management immediately.





How to Apply



Address your message directly to Lewis. Applications that utilize generic or automated titles (such as "Dear Sir/Ma'am," "Respected Hiring Manager") may not be considered.

Include your portfolio link, please make sure it shows real samples of your work (e.g. captions you wrote, posts you published, documents you’ve created,
s you’ve sent or layouts you designed). Please do not share pages of client testimonials.

Please include a short cover letter explaining why you want to apply for this role and your experience with UK audiences.





The Trial Project Phase (Paid Project)



Dates & Deadlines: The trial project phase starts toward the end of July 2026. This will be a timed, paid evaluation project.

title: Government Contract Opportunity & Subcontractor Research Specialist
description:
Executive Choices is seeking a detail-oriented government contracting specialist to identify and evaluate federal contract opportunities on SAM.gov for a Total Small Business.



This role is ideal for someone who understands federal solicitations, FAR requirements, small-business set-asides, subcontractor sourcing, and the practical steps needed to prepare a competitive government proposal.



Responsibilities:

• Search SAM.gov for active solicitations that fit Executive Choices’ capabilities and a prime-contractor/subcontractor delivery model.

• Read the complete solicitation package, amendments, attachments, clauses, and instructions.

• Confirm eligibility, including Total Small Business set-aside requirements, NAICS codes, deadlines, place of performance, certifications, and relevant FAR/agency clauses.

• Evaluate whether each opportunity is realistic, profitable, manageable, and suitable for subcontracting.

• Identify compliance risks, mandatory qualifications, required documents, and bid/no-bid concerns.

• Find qualified subcontractors or vendors capable of performing the work.

• Obtain and document at least three comparable quotes for each recommended opportunity.

• Compare price, scope, availability, experience, past performance, and compliance—not price alone—and recommend the best-value option.

• Organize all findings into a clear proposal-ready package for the owner to review and submit.

• Track questions, amendments, deadlines, vendor communications, and submission requirements.



Required experience:

• Hands-on experience researching opportunities on SAM.gov.

• Strong working knowledge of the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and federal solicitation structure.

• Ability to interpret Total Small Business set-asides and subcontracting limitations.

• Experience with solicitation analysis, compliance matrices, vendor research, RFQs, and quote comparison.

• Excellent written English, organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.

• Ability to explain complex solicitation requirements in plain language.



For each opportunity, you will submit:

1. SAM.gov notice link and solicitation number.

2. Plain-English opportunity summary.

3. Eligibility and fit assessment.

4. Bid/no-bid recommendation with reasoning.

5. Compliance checklist and proposal instructions.

6. Important FAR/agency clauses, deadlines, risks, and questions.

7. At least three subcontractor/vendor quotes with contact details and comparison.

8. Recommended best-value subcontractor and supporting rationale.

9. Complete source files and a proposal-ready handoff package.



To apply, begin your message with the words “FAR READY” and briefly describe one federal solicitation you analyzed, the FAR or compliance issues you identified, and how you sourced vendors or subcontractors. Applications without this example will not be considered.

title: Walmart Operations Lead
description:
Zoyava is a fast-growing digital-native supplement brand focused on building premium wellness products that consumers genuinely love. As we continue scaling across major eCommerce marketplaces, Walmart Marketplace has become a key strategic growth channel for the business.



We are looking for a highly experienced Walmart Operations Lead to take ownership of Walmart Marketplace performance, drive operational excellence, and help scale the channel into a major revenue driver for the company.



This is a leadership role for someone who understands Walmart deeply, thinks strategically about growth, communicates clearly with leadership, and can build scalable systems across catalog, advertising, inventory, promotions, and reporting.



Who We’re Looking For



We’re seeking a highly analytical, growth-oriented operator with deep Walmart Marketplace experience who can lead the day-to-day operations and long-term strategy of the Walmart channel.



This role is ideal for someone who has successfully scaled brands on Walmart Marketplace, understands Walmart Connect advertising, knows how to improve operational performance, and can proactively identify growth opportunities while keeping leadership informed through strong reporting and business insights.



You should be comfortable owning the Walmart business like it’s your own.



Key Responsibilities



Walmart Marketplace Ownership

• Own channel growth, revenue performance, profitability, and operational execution.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) – B2B Cold Calling & Appointment Setting
description:
FULL-TIME SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (SDR)

B2B COLD CALLING & APPOINTMENT SETTING



ABOUT MARGINX



MarginX is a restaurant profitability and operations software platform built for restaurant owners and operators.



Our platform helps restaurants identify and control profit leaks across food costs, labour costs, inventory, purchasing, recipes, waste, vendor pricing, operational processes, and overall profitability.



We are hiring an experienced Sales Development Representative to contact restaurant owners and decision-makers across Canada and the United States, conduct brief discovery conversations, qualify prospective clients, and book product demonstrations for the MarginX sales team.



This is a full-time, remote, outbound cold-calling position.



The primary responsibility of this role is not customer service or administrative support. The selected candidate will be responsible for speaking directly with business owners, creating interest in MarginX, identifying operational challenges, handling objections, and booking qualified product demonstrations.



Prospect lists will be provided. The SDR’s primary responsibility will be calling, qualification, follow-up, and appointment setting.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Make a high volume of outbound calls to restaurant owners, franchisees, operators, general managers, and other decision-makers.



• Introduce MarginX clearly, confidently, and professionally.



• Explain how MarginX helps restaurants improve profitability and gain better control over food costs, labour costs, inventory, purchasing, recipes, waste, and operational performance.



• Speak directly with business owners and identify whether the restaurant is a suitable potential customer for MarginX.



• Conduct brief discovery conversations to understand the prospect’s current challenges.



• Ask relevant questions about the restaurant’s locations, operations, food costs, labour costs, inventory, waste, purchasing, profitability, and current systems.



• Identify pain points and connect those problems to the appropriate MarginX capabilities.



• Qualify prospects based on business type, number of locations, operational needs, decision-making authority, interest, and suitability.



• Book qualified product demonstrations with restaurant owners and relevant decision-makers.



• Clearly explain what the prospect can expect during the product demonstration.



• Confirm the prospect’s name, business name, contact details, number of restaurant locations, appointment date, appointment time, and relevant discovery information.



• Follow up with interested prospects who are not ready to book immediately.



• Confirm upcoming demonstrations and help reduce cancellations and no-shows.



• Reschedule qualified prospects who miss or postpone their demonstrations.



• Maintain accurate and complete records of every call, conversation, objection, follow-up, and appointment in the company CRM.



• Provide detailed discovery notes to the sales representative conducting the demonstration.



• Follow company-approved scripts, qualification criteria, call processes, and CRM procedures.



• Participate in sales training, role-playing exercises, call reviews, coaching sessions, and performance meetings.



• Consistently work toward agreed calling, conversation, qualification, appointment-booking, and attendance targets.



COMMON PROBLEMS YOU WILL DISCUSS WITH PROSPECTS



The SDR should be comfortable discussing restaurant challenges such as:



• Rising food costs

• High labour costs

• Food waste

• Inventory discrepancies

• Inconsistent recipe costing

• Poor portion control

• Vendor price increases

• Difficulty tracking profitability

• Lack of real-time operational visibility

• Inconsistent processes between restaurant locations

• Difficulty understanding actual margins

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands: one in travel accessories and one in beauty devices, with 52+ active SKUs. We're at a turning point: moving from a founder-run business to a properly managed, systems-run company. This role is central to that transition.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is an operations and team management position for someone who has done this before in an ecommerce or Amazon environment.

You will report directly to the two Founders and manage a team of 8-9 people across our Creative and Operations teams. You'll take our existing processes - currently scattered and undocumented --and build a proper system in ClickUp from scratch. You'll create SOPs, track KPIs, run tea
etings, and make sure everyone knows what they're doing and when.

Your mission is to build the systems, rhythm, and accountability that let the company run smoothly, without the founders being involved in every daily decision.

If you need someone to tell you what to do every day, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and the autonomy to build real systems, keep reading.



What You'll Do:

- Set up ClickUp from scratch across all departments: workflows, dashboards, automations, task structures

- Make sure all work is captured in the system - nothing managed informally or lost in chat

- Coordinate between Creative and Operations teams so projects move smoothly

- Document existing business processes into clear, usable SOPs

- Handle day-to-day approvals within defined boundaries, escalating only real issues to the founders

- Lead weekly/monthly KPI reviews and quarterly planning sessions

- Run the weekly tea
eting - status updates, blockers, decisions - focused and on time

- Translate founders' quarterly objectives into clear team and individual goals

- Monitor performance, spot problems early, and drive corrective action

- Build and manage the product-launch workflow based on the existing 15-step launch process

- Spot what's slowing the team down and fix it - don't just flag it

- Keep an eye on profitability alongside the founders

- Onboard new hires: set up tools, assign SOPs, guide their first weeks

mber (raise, warning, letting someone go, promotion) that was yours to make?

title: Travel, Operations & Research Assistant for International Healthcare Content Creator
description:
Travel, Operations & Research Assistant for International Healthcare Content Creator



Location: Remote

Type: Part-time to start, with potential to grow

Compensation: $700 USD per month

Languages: Fluent English required. Fluent or highly proficient Spanish strongly preferred. Mandarin/Chinese is a major plus.



About Me



I’m building Jen’s Side Quests, a travel and social media project focused on exploring healthcare systems around the world, sharing what I learn with my audience, and eventually creating a Side Quest Scholarship program that helps people access life-changing healthcare and other opportunities they might not otherwise be able to afford.



I’m currently traveling internationally and creating content around healthcare, culture, food, and unique experiences.



I’m looking for someone who wants to be part of building something meaningful—not simply completing administrative tasks.



I need a proactive, organized, warm, curious, and thoughtful person who can help me stay on track while also helping me research, plan, and develop the larger vision of the project.



I am looking for someone who can become a trusted part of my team over time.



?



The Role



I’m looking for a Travel, Operations & Research Assistant who can help me manage my schedule, strategically plan my travel, research healthcare systems, discover content opportunities, and build relationships with hospitals, clinics, and other potential partners.



This role is a combination of:



* Executive/Personal Assistant

* Travel Planner

* Operations Coordinator

* Research Assistant

* Healthcare Researcher

* Partnership Outreach Assistant



I don’t just want someone who waits for me to tell them what to do.



I want someone who can think alongside me.



For example, instead of me saying:



“I want to learn about healthcare in this city.”



I would love for you to help me turn that into:



“I’ve researched the healthcare system in this city. Here are three public hospitals, two private clinics, and one dental clinic that would be interesting for your content. I’ve contacted the private clinics to see if they would be willing to give you a tour or speak with you. Here’s the schedule I’ve created for your week.”



I want someone who can help me turn my ideas into an actual plan.



?



1. Strategic Travel Planning & Itinerary Development



This is a very important part of the role.



I travel internationally for extended periods of time, and I want someone who can help me think strategically about where I should go, how long I should stay, and what I should accomplish in each location.



I would like you to help me think several weeks or months ahead and create an evolving travel plan based on:



* Where I am currently located.

* Where I want to go next.

* Affordable and efficient transportation options.

* Bus routes vs. flights.

* Cost of accommodation and living.

* Seasonal weather and events.

* Visa and travel considerations.

* Opportunities to create content.

* Healthcare systems and stories worth exploring.

* Hospitals and clinics I can visit.

* Potential partnerships and sponsorship opportunities.

* How long I should realistically stay in each location.

* How to minimize unnecessary travel expenses.



I would like to have a living 1–3 month travel roadmap that we continuously update together.



For example, I would like you to be able to look at my next few months and say:



“I think you should spend the next 2–3 weeks in Mexico City because there are several healthcare stories and clinic relationships we can develop. Then you could take a bus to Oaxaca for 10 days to create cultural content. After that, I recommend flying to Colombia because the flight is inexpensive and you have existing contacts there. You could spend 3–4 weeks in Medellín, then travel to Bogotá for 1–2 weeks before continuing south.”



I don’t expect you to make every decision for me.



I want you to research options, make recommendations, explain your reasoning, and help me decide.



I want someone who proactively says:



“I think you should go here next.”



“I found a cheaper and more efficient way to get there.”



“I think you should stay another week because this clinic wants to meet you.”



“You have three healthcare opportunities in this city, so I think it’s worth staying for two more weeks.”



“There’s a major cultural event happening in the next city, so we should consider adjusting your route.”



I want you to help me see the bigger picture and turn it into a practical itinerary.



?



2. Calendar & Schedule Management



Help me organize my day-to-day life and make sure my plans actually happen.



Responsibilities may include:



* Manage and organize my calendar.

* Help create realistic weekly schedules.

* Schedule filming days, meetings, interviews, appointments, and travel.

* Schedule hospital and clinic visits.

* Help prioritize my time.

* Make sure important tasks and follow-ups don’t get forgotten.

* Provide daily or weekly reminders and check-ins.

* Help me stay accountable to my content and business goals.

* Help me balance travel, filming, editing, business development, and personal time.



I would love to have regular check-ins where we review:



What am I doing this week?

What are my top priorities?

What needs to happen next?

What should I be doing today?



?



3. Travel Planning & Logistics



Help me research and organize:



* Flights.

* Buses.

* Trains.

* Local transportation.

* Affordable accommodations.

* Longer-term apartment or hotel stays.

* Travel routes between countries and cities.



I travel with only a carry-on and backpack, so I want to prioritize efficient, affordable travel.



Help me compare options based on:



* Price.

* Travel time.

* Convenience.

* Safety.

* Content opportunities.

* Location of accommodation.

* Whether the route makes sense as part of my larger travel plan.



Help keep all travel information, reservations, and itineraries organized in one place.



?



4. Healthcare Research



This is one of the most important parts of the role.



For each country or city I visit, I would like you to research:



* How the healthcare system works.

* Public vs. private healthcare.

* Typical costs for common medical procedures.

* Cost of dental care.

* Cost of medical consultations.

* Cost of surgeries when reliable information is available.

* How healthcare costs compare with the United States.

* Whether foreigners can access healthcare.

* How public hospitals differ from private clinics.

* Which hospitals and clinics are known for serving international patients.

* Which facilities may be interesting for me to visit and feature in my content.



I would like this information organized in a clear database or spreadsheet with reliable sources so that I can easily reference it when creating videos.



?



5. Hospital & Clinic Outreach



Help me identify hospitals, clinics, dentists, and other healthcare providers that I can potentially visit.



Responsibilities may include:



* Finding relevant public hospitals.

* Finding reputable private hospitals and clinics.

* Identifying healthcare providers that may be open to international visitors or media.

* Identifying the appropriate contact person.

* Finding
 addresses and contact information.

* Drafting outreach
s in English or Spanish.

* Following up with organizations.

* Helping schedule tours, interviews, and meetings.

* Maintaining a database of outreach and responses.

* Helping me prepare questions before each visit.



For example, if I’m traveling to a new city, I would love for you to proactively research:



“Here are five healthcare facilities you should consider visiting. This one is a major public hospital. This one is a private clinic known for international patients. This one specializes in dental care. I’ve reached out to two of them and one has responded.”



I want to build long-term relationships with reputable healthcare providers around the world.



?



6. Discovering Content & “Side Quest” Opportunities



I want someone who can proactively research and suggest ideas.



For example:



“You’re going to Bogotá next month. I found a public hospital that treats a large number of patients and a private clinic that specializes in international patients. I think you should contact both.”



Or:



“Dental care in this city appears to be significantly less expensive than in the U.S. Here are five clinics worth contacting.”



Or:



“There’s a major cultural festival happening while you’re there. I think you should extend your stay by a week.”



Or:



“There’s a public hospital near your accommodation that you could visit to learn about how the healthcare system works.”



I don’t want someone who waits for me to tell them exactly what to do.



I want someone who thinks alongside me, notices opportunities, and helps me discover new possibilities.



?



7. Research & Statistics



Help me collect accurate and reliable information about:



* Healthcare costs.

* Healthcare access.

* Public vs. private healthcare.

* Medical tourism.

* Insurance systems.

* Healthcare quality.

* Common procedures and their costs.

* Healthcare comparisons between countries.



Information should be organized and sourced so that I can use it responsibly in my content.



?



8. General Operations



Help me keep the entire project organized.



Responsibilities may include:



* Organizing files and documents.

* Maintaining spreadsheets and databases.

* Tracking contacts and partnerships.

* Helping manage
 communication.

* Keeping track of upcoming travel and projects.

* Creating weekly plans and monthly goals.

* Tracking outreach and follow-ups.

* Helping organize content ideas.

* Helping manage my schedule.

* Assisting with other administrative tasks as the project grows.



?



The Ideal Candidate



I’m looking for someone who is:



* Fluent in English.

* Fluent or highly proficient in Spanish.

* Mandarin/Chinese language skills are a major bonus.

* Highly organized and detail-oriented.

* Proactive and able to work independently.

* Warm, kind, and easy to communicate with.

* Comfortable communicating professionally with hospitals, clinics, and businesses.

* Interested in travel and international cultures.

* Curious about healthcare and social impact.

* Comfortable researching information online.

* Good at Google Sheets and Google Calendar.

* Comfortable learning new software and organizational systems.

* Able to manage multiple projects without becoming overwhelmed.

* A strong written communicator.

* Good at thinking strategically and looking several steps ahead.



Most importantly, I’m looking for someone who is kind, trustworthy, proactive, thoughtful, and genuinely excited to help build something meaningful.



I want to find someone who I enjoy communicating with and who I can eventually trust as an important part of my team.



?



Compensation



$700 USD per month



This is a part-time position to start.



I am happy to invest in a truly excellent assistant who is reliable, proactive, organized, and able to bring real value to the project.



The role has the potential to grow over time if we are a great fit and the project continues to develop.



?



What I Hope This Role Can Become



I don’t necessarily want this to be a short-term VA position.



I hope to find someone who can grow with the project.



As Jen’s Side Quests develops, I would love for this person to potentially become involved in:



* Healthcare partnerships.

* International clinic relationships.

* Sponsorships.

* Travel logistics.

* Content planning.

* Side Quest Scholarship planning.

* Coordinating future scholarship recipients.

* Organizing healthcare opportunities for people in need.



The long-term goal is to build a project that uses media, partnerships, and sponsorships to help people access opportunities—including healthcare—that they might not otherwise be able to afford.



If you’re someone who wants to help build something from the beginning, I would love to hear from you.



?



To Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your work experience.

3. The languages you speak and your level of proficiency.

4. Your experience with travel planning, research, scheduling, or operations.

5. Your availability and preferred working hours.

6. Your expected monthly rate or hourly rate.

7. A short answer to this question:



If I told you I was traveling to a new country next month and wanted to create a series about healthcare there, what would you research and organize for me before I arrived?



I would also love to hear how you would approach this:



Imagine I am currently in Mexico and want to spend the next three months traveling through Latin America while creating healthcare content. How would you help me decide which countries and cities to visit, how long to stay in each place, and what I should research or arrange before arriving?



I’m especially interested in seeing how you think, how proactive you are, and how you would approach the project.

We are not interested in spammy backlinks or black-hat SEO tactics.



Competitive Research

Discover content gaps.

Monitor emerging search trends.

Recommend strategies to outperform competitors.

Analytics & Reporting

Google Search Console

Ahrefs

Semrush

Screaming Frog

Organic traffic growth

to ensure SEO best practices are integrated into every project.

Experience building high-quality backlinks

Exceptional attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

WordPress

Elementor

Cloudflare

Google Tag Manager

Looker Studio

BrightLocal

Whitespark

Schema.org

AI-assisted SEO workflows

What Success Looks Like

Growth in organic leads and conversions

High-quality backlinks earned

Improved domain authority

Expanded topical authority

title: Mitigation & Rebuild Estimator
description:
========================================================

UTAH RESTORATION COMPANY

Mitigation & Rebuild Estimator

========================================================

Utah County / Salt Lake County | Full-Time | Hourly



IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING

--------------------------------------

Please read through the entire job posting and application

instructions before submitting your application.



Applications that do not follow the instructions will not

be considered. No exceptions.



--------------------------------------------------------

ABOUT US

--------------------------------------------------------

Utah Restoration Company is a fast-growing restoration and

reconstruction firm specializing in water damage mitigation,

mold remediation, fire restoration, and property reconstruction.

We deliver exceptional service to homeowners, property managers,

and insurance carriers across Utah County and Salt Lake County.



We are a team-first company committed to accuracy, speed, and

professionalism — and we are looking for an estimator who

shares those values.



--------------------------------------------------------

POSITION SUMMARY

--------------------------------------------------------

The Mitigation & Rebuild Estimator is responsible for producing

accurate, complete Xactimate estimates for water, mold, and fire

mitigation projects as well as rebuild work.



You will review field documentation, photographs, Matterport

scans, technician notes, equipment logs, and project scopes —

and turn them into professional estimates within a 24-hour

turnaround window.



This is a remote-friendly, high-output role. You will work

independently with clear expectations, strong documentation

support from our field team, and the backing of a leadership

team invested in your success.



--------------------------------------------------------

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

--------------------------------------------------------



ESTIMATE PREPARATION

• Write accurate mitigation and rebuild estimates using Xactimate

• Complete and submit estimates within 24 hours of receiving

project documentation

• Review technician notes, production manager notes, moisture

maps, equipment logs, and project scopes

• Ensure all work performed is properly documented and captured

in estimates



DOCUMENTATION REVIEW

• Analyze jobsite photographs to identify water damage,

demolition, drying equipment, contents manipulation, and

specialty drying systems

• Verify all scope items against field documentation

• Use pre- and post-mitigation documentation to identify scope

of work, materials, quantities, and additional adjuster info



MATTERPORT & SKETCHING

• Utilize Matterport scans and 3D imaging to build accurate

Xactimate sketches

• Measure and sketch room dimensions, cabinets, doors, windows,

closets, appliances, fixtures, and built-in features

• Ensure sketches accurately represent the affected structure



EQUIPMENT BILLING

• Review drying logs and monitoring reports

• Identify and accurately bill for air movers, dehumidifiers,

air scrubbers, HEPA filtration equipment, Injectidry systems,

and specialty drying equipment

• Calculate proper equipment duration and billing



CONTENTS ESTIMATING

• Estimate contents manipulation, packing/unpacking labor,

and storage-related activities

• Document and bill for furniture movement and protection



QUALITY CONTROL

• Verify estimate accuracy before every submission

• Confirm all documentation supports billed line items

• Ensure compliance with company procedures and industry

standards



--------------------------------------------------------

QUALIFICATIONS

--------------------------------------------------------

REQUIRED

• Hands-on experience with Xactimate

• Restoration industry experience

• Solid understanding of water mitigation processes

• Ability to interpret field photos and documentation

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines consistently



PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED)

• IICRC Certifications: WRT, ASD, or AMRT

• Experience with Matterport

• Experience working directly with insurance claims

• Prior mitigation estimating experience



--------------------------------------------------------

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

--------------------------------------------------------

• 24-hour estimate turnaround time — consistently

• High accuracy with minimal revision requests

• Proper documentation of all billable work and activities

• Accurate equipment billing and duration tracking

• Professional communication with production staff and management



--------------------------------------------------------

WHAT WE OFFER

--------------------------------------------------------

• Competitive hourly compensation

• Performance bonus opportunities

• Career advancement in a growing company

• Ongoing training and professional development

• Supportive, team-first culture

• Real leadership opportunities as we scale



--------------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

--------------------------------------------------------

Send your application to: 

----------

Subject Line: Utah Restoration - Mitigation and Rebuild Estimator

Your application must include ALL of the following:



• Resume

• Xactimate Experience Summary — describe the types of estimates

you have written and your proficiency level

• Restoration Industry Experience — summarize your background

in water mitigation, fire, mold, or reconstruction

• Relevant Certifications (if any)



Reminder: Applications that do not follow the instructions

above will not be considered.





Join Utah Restoration Company and help us deliver

industry-leading restoration services while building a

rewarding career in a growing organization.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Part-Time B2B Cold Caller & Appointment Setter for U.S. Freight Brokerage — HubSpot Experience Preferred
description:
COMPANY



Carolina Cargo Solutions is a growing U.S.-based freight brokerage located in Charlotte, North Carolina. We help manufacturers, distributors, construction-material suppliers, and other shippers secure reliable transportation capacity throughout the United States.



We are hiring a dependable, confident, and organized Virtual Assistant to help build our shipper pipeline through prospect research, cold calling, appointment setting, follow-up
s, and accurate CRM data entry.



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person. We are looking to hire immediately.



POSITION DETAILS



• Part-time: Approximately 20 hours per week

• Monday through Friday

• Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

• Starting rate: $6–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience

• Performance bonuses available for qualified appointments

• Paid trial period before permanent placement

• Payment schedule and method will be agreed upon before starting



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Research manufacturers, distributors, building-material suppliers, and other companies that regularly ship freight

• Identify logistics managers, transportation managers, supply-chain managers, shipping managers, operations managers, and business owners

• Make professional outbound calls to prospective shippers

• Navigate receptionists and gatekeepers respectfully

• Introduce Carolina Cargo Solutions and identify potential shipping needs

• Ask qualifying questions about freight type, equipment, shipping lanes, volume, current challenges, and decision-making authority

• Schedule qualified appointments with the company owner

• Send approved follow-up
s after calls

• Enter all leads, call outcomes, notes, contact information, and follow-up tasks into HubSpot

• Maintain clean and accurate CRM records

• Follow up consistently with interested prospects

• Help build and organize targeted prospect lists

• Submit a short daily activity report

• Provide a weekly report showing calls, conversations, decision-makers reached, follow-ups, and appointments booked



A qualified appointment means that you have spoken with a relevant decision-maker, confirmed that the company ships freight or has a transportation need, gathered useful qualifying information, and scheduled a meeting that the prospect has agreed to attend. Simply placing an unconfirmed meeting on the calendar does not count as a qualified appointment.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Previous B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

• Clear, confident, and professional spoken English

• Strong written English

• Comfortable speaking with U.S. business owners and logistics decision-makers

• Experience handling gatekeepers and common objections

• Accurate CRM data-entry and note-taking skills

• Reliable computer, headset, high-speed internet, and quiet workspace

• Able to work independently and follow scripts, procedures, and daily targets

• Dependable attendance and communication

• Comfortable receiving coaching and reviewing call performance



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Experience with HubSpot CRM

• Freight brokerage, trucking, logistics, dispatching, manufacturing, construction, wholesale, or supply-chain experience

• Experience using Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, Google Maps, or similar prospecting tools

• Experience with cold
 and follow-up sequences

• Familiarity with U.S. geography, states, cities, and time zones



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



The successful candidate will be measured on:



• Consistent attendance and punctuality

• Quality outbound-call activity

• Number of decision-makers reached

• Accuracy and completeness of HubSpot records

• Quality of prospect qualification

• Completed qualified appointments

• Professional communication

• Consistent follow-up

• Improvement after coaching



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words: “CCS FREIGHT VA.”



Please include all of the following:



Your requested hourly rate

Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time

The number of hours you can work each week

A summary of your B2B cold-calling and appointment-setting experience

Any freight, trucking, logistics, manufacturing, or supply-chain experience

Your experience using HubSpot or another CRM

The average number of outbound calls you have handled per day

A link to a 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are a good fit

A screenshot or description of your internet speed and backup connection

A short written response to this situation:



“You call a manufacturing company, and the receptionist says, ‘We already have transportation providers and are not interested.’ What would you say next?”



Applications without the requested voice recording and written response will not receive priority.



PAID SKILLS TRIAL



Selected applicants may be invited to complete a short paid trial that includes:



• Reviewing a CCS call script

• Making sample or supervised calls

• Handling a gatekeeper objection

• Qualifying a sample shipper

• Entering sample information into a CRM

• Writing a brief follow-up

• Submitting a daily activity report



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Carolina Cargo Solutions, take ownership of the prospecting process, and help build lasting shipper relationships.

title: Social Media Manager and Editor - Australian Mission Driven Org
description:
Read to the end. There's a special instruction for applying, and we'll know if you skipped it.



We're OKR Quickstart, a small remote-first consultancy in Australia. We help business leaders set clear goals and actually hit them (that's what OKR means: Objectives and Key Results, one clear goal tracked by a few honest numbers). We also coach product management, the work of building products customers actually want.



We want one person to own our LinkedIn and YouTube, with some podcast work, plus a little light admin and sales support.



Own is the key word. We don't want someone who waits to be told what to post. We want someone with a point of view: you take our talks, articles, and recordings and d
 how to turn them into content that grows an audience.



Curating is tidying up what exists and scheduling it. Owning is d
 what good looks like here and holding that standard. We mean owning.





What you'll do:

1. Edit video and podcast content in CapCut (our main editing tool): trims, audio cleanup, captions, simple text overlays. Basic to start, we train you on the rest.



2. Post and schedule across LinkedIn, YouTube, and podcast platforms, consistently.

Shape our house style and formats. House style is the look, tone, and repeatable templates that make our content feel like us. You help build it, not just follow it.



3. Repurpose what we already have into new formats and channels.



4. Bring content ideas. Regularly.



5. Report on what's performing so we can see what's growing the audience.



6. Track what's working on LinkedIn and YouTube right now, and bring it back to us.



7. Give honest feedback on content, including to the founder.



8. Light admin, plus moving prospects through our CRM and LinkedIn chat. No phone selling.







How we work:

1. The founder travels a lot, so you run your own days. Self-managing means you plan your week, keep your commitments, and ship work when nobody's watching.



2. Flag problems early. Internet drops, a login you can't get, anything blocking you: you tell us the day it happens, not next week.



3. We have a weekly team call. Everyone brings their list of asks and blockers. You'll do the same.



4. You also hold us accountable. If we owe you a file, a login, or a decision by a date, chase us for it. That's the job done well, not rudeness.







Must have:

1. A real track record on LinkedIn and YouTube specifically. Show us what you've grown and what changed because of you.



2. Native-level English, written and spoken. Our audience is English-speaking business leaders.



3. Basic video and audio editing, ideally in CapCut (we'll train you up).



4. The self-management and communication habits above. 





For us, these are the role's nice-to-haves:

1. Copywriting (a real bonus, not required).



2. Miro, Canva, iMovie or similar. Photoshop is a bonus.







What you'll need:

1. Reliable internet with a genuine backup plan: mobile data, a second provider, or a co-working space. A single point of failure won't work.



2. Equipment that can handle video and audio editing.







How to apply:

1. Send content examples or a portfolio, plus your CV or profile. LinkedIn and YouTube work especially.



2. If we like it, a short, real, paid test task. You create something, we pay you for it. No unpaid trials.

- Round 1 interview with a tea
mber.

- Round 2 interview with the founder.





Special instruction: start your application with the word **
NTUM**. Then, in a sentence or two, name one piece of content you grew, and one thing you'd change about how a business like ours shows up on LinkedIn.

 • Tagging and segmentation. A clean, logical CRM structure where every tag means something and our lists can actually be trusted.

 • Evergreen nurture sequences.
 and SMS that run on their own and move people toward our programs, events, and retreats. Welcome, reactivation, and post-event flows that don’t need us to press send.

 • Pages. Landing, funnel, checkout, and thank-you pages built inside GHL, including payment plans, discount codes, and clean Spiffy-to-ConvertAndFlow handoffs. Templatized so launches stop being built from scratch every time.

 • Workflow QA. Every automation tested before it goes live, not debugged after. No more “it’s not working” surprises on launch day.

 • AI-assisted automation. Build and improve AI-assisted follow-up and messaging, and help keep our 
 scenarios running.

 • SOPs. Document every system as you build it, unprompted, so a non-technical teammate can follow it.



Week to week



 • Support our weekly Tuesday webinar loop: after each one, update the landing page and ads and adjust the next campaign

 • Build and troubleshoot workflows, tags, and pages for upcoming launches, events, and retreats

 • Monitor deliverability, engagement, and drop-off, and report what the numbers say

 • Proactively flag gaps and recommend the next build



You’re a strong fit if you



 • Have proven, hands-on GoHighLevel experience and can show real builds

 • Understand CRM logic, conditional workflows, and tagging deeply

 deliverability, not just
 sending

How we work



Part-time, long-term, remote, deliverable-based. Required team huddles Mon 9am EST and Tue, Thu, Fri 9:30am EST. We start with one small paid test build before committing long term.



What success looks like



 • First 30 days: full audit of our GHL location, deliverability basics fixed, tagging cleaned up, and what exists documented.

  - Independently search for and identify suitable influencers/KOLs based on our platform’s business needs, target audience, and campaign goals.

  - Cover major social media platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and
.

2. Outreach & Partnership Communication

  - Clearly introduce our platform, cooperation model, campaign goals, and content requirements to potential influencers.

  - Manage influencer outreach, follow-ups, initial negotiation, cooperation confirmation, and ongoing communication.

5. Data Collection & Campaign Review

mbers or supporting staff.

3. Familiarity with major social media platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, and
.

title: Tiktok Music Marketing
description:
Use Job Description

Are you tapped in with US TikTok culture, Gen Z trends and internet music?

Do you love pop, electropop, 2000s bangers or, even better, hyperpop/digicore?

Or do you steal like an artist, know how to remix a trending concept & capture

people's attention with shareable & engaging (faceless) content?

If so, this role might be for you!



???? Who we are

My team & I are growing fast & we have been gaining a lot of industry attention.

From popular influencers to media outlets.



We are a small team operating at start-up speed with big agency level tools.

Some of our posts were even liked by celebrities like Kim Petras, and the hottest

underground artists, tastemakers & curators.



I’d love to hire someone who can raise the bar and help us get to the next level of tiktok

marketing for music.

???? Who we are looking for



Content creation and a strong understanding of US internet culture are key.



Ideally you are a fan of the music that inspires our brand, the underground music scene

(hyperpop, digicore, asian underground).



We are inspired by new-gen digicore/hyperpop artists like Jane Remover, Effie & Tiffany

Day but also more known kpop acts like BigBang, 2NE1 & newjeans as well as timeless

2000s, 2010s electropop.



You may also excel in this role if you know exactly how to spin trending formats into our

niche. Great taste, great intuition and an undeniable grasp on internet culture, humor &

analytical mind that can identify, execute & scale winning formats as fast as they can cut

losing ones.



Role Overview

Under our brand guidance you produce, post, and track short-form content on TikTok.

The content will be faceless, so you can source assets from all over the internet (think

music fanpages, music promo pages, or brainrot like paparazzi tok, fadetok).



Examples:











Your job will be to use our music and create content with it by wrapping it into trending

TikTok formats for music marketing, e.g. slideshows, memes, fashion, lifestyle, popular US

TV Show, swag, literally anything you can think of in US Internet Culture.

We are 100% results-driven: you will have tools to cutting edge market data (daily

engagement & impact) and be able to iterate on your ideas extremely fast.



You will develop rigorous analytical & creative skills that are transferable to any market or

industry & will set you apart from your competitors.



This is a great opportunity for high-achievers passionate about music, Gen Z culture, and

social media marketing. ?

???? Responsibilities

1. Content Production (Ordered By Priority)

• Create engaging content to market our music

2. Content Analysis

• Research TikTok & music marketing trends and viral formats across TikTok

• Develop and manage a weekly content calendar for multiple accounts (we have extensive

tools to track your content performance and benchmark them against competitors)

• Monitor performance metrics (views, saves, conversions, followers), compile weekly

reports & adjust strategy accordingly ?



? REQUIRED Qualifications

• Demonstrated experience with short-form content on TikTok, preferably 1year+

• Creative and driven individual who loves experimenting with content, editing and

autonomous work (no micro-managing)

• Ability to capture and edit fast-turnaround video using CapCut or other editing software

• Strong understanding of social media & what makes content resonate with target markets.

Taste is your strongest asset here.

• Superb analytical skills. No sugar coating. Fast decision making. Right conclusion under

sparse data. Aware of psychological & logical fallacies.

• Meme literacy and strong grasp of Internet culture, youth & Zeitgeist

• Highly organized, self-directed, and capable of managing multiple tasks and content

pipelines

• Strong written presenting results/insights

• Preferred: Interest in the US music industry and/or understanding of underground music

scene

?

What You Get

• Supportive and kind environment to grow as a VA, creative and social media expert.

Strong team with mutual trust and respect, no backstabbing, politics, toxicity of any kind.

Team mates are seen as assets to develop and we all grow, help each other out & celebrate

wins together.

If a team mate falls behind, we address it directly and help them get back to speed.

• Competitive pay: Your compensation should reflect your impact on our business & the

value of your skills & experience.

The advertised pay is based on a 25 hour work week with upwards trajectory potential to go

full-time.



We are happy to negotiate towards your ask rate and will adjust compensation yearly based

on performance and current market data.

We reward high impact, not mere output or activity.

Once your work has a measurable impact on our metrics (fan acquisition, music streams,

industry outreach), you will gain leverage for higher paying scope & benefits.

• Regular performance feedback to grow to a global top player: we measure our output

+ impact rigorously & have worked with the biggest labels and tech companies in the US.

We have beaten marketing agencies at their own game & created viral content that

captured attention from celebrities & the biggest players in our industry.



We know how to make you grow.

• Freedom of being an independent contractor but with full-time benefits (PH holidays off,

earned paid days off, pro-rated 13th salary, sick leave, reimbursement for equipment to

improve your workflow) once you exit the trial period of 3 months or less

• Long-term growth: this role is expected to turn into a full-time role with competitive pay &

benefits depending on your needs (we want to provide the best to the best).

Once we see your taste is there & scaling your hours would lead to higher impact, we are

happy to bring you on-board for 40h/week, or as you desire. (1 hire did go full time within 3

weeks).



This can be a sustainable role for years to come, and high performers & bar raisers may

stay for the duration of their entire career.

• Access to latest professional software licenses as needed

• Flexible work days/hours (minimal meetings, work whenever/wherever as long as you

deliver results).

Caveat: you need to post during highly active times on our primary market (USA) & be

available for your team mates and 1:1s (we are flexible, though).

?

Interview Process

After initial resume screening, there will be two trial tasks:

1) create 2-3 pieces of content (incl. description/hashtags) + description on why you

think those will do well (30-60+ minutes)

2) Analyze performance of TikToks (real world data) + write a brief paragraph and

concrete improvement steps (15-30+ minutes)

Both tasks are equally important and extremely reflective of your day to day work.

Quick interview with a hiring manager and a team mate (45-60 min. each) for long-term

cultural fit.



Unfortunately we cannot offer to pay for the trial tasks, but we won’t ever use your intellectual

property.



Those are solely for evaluating your skill set & potential for success in our team.

As a token of appreciation, we may offer to give you brief feedback on what went wrong and

how to improve in future interviews.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Position Overview

The Human Resources Specialist supports the day-to-day execution of key HR programs. Working directly with employees, hiring managers, and HR leadership, you will help administer core processes like onboarding, benefits, and policy compliance. The ideal candidate is highly organized, possesses excellent communication skills, and maintains a deep understanding of human resource best practices.



Key Responsibilities

1. Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

Partner with department managers to define role requirements and draft compelling job postings. Source, screen, and interview candidates, ensuring a strong, diverse talent pipeline. Coordinate the interview process, conduct background checks, and manage offer letters. Lead engaging new-hire orientations, ensuring seamless integration into the company culture.



2. Benefits & Compensation Administration

Serve as the primary point of contact for employee questions regarding health insurance, retirement plans, and leave policies. Process benefits enrollment, changes, and terminations, and assist with annual open enrollment. Review compensation data to ensure accuracy and internal equity.



3. Compliance & Record Keeping

Ensure all HR practices, policies, and hiring procedures comply with local, state, and federal labor laws. Maintain accurate, highly confidential employee records, utilizing HR Information Systems (HRIS).

-Creating, implementing, and evaluating all human resource department policies, procedures, and structures.

-Managing health and life insurance programs.

-Designing and implementing effective training and development plans.

-Performing quarterly and annual surveys.

-Ensuring all employee records are maintained and updated with new hire information or changes in employment status.



Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: 2–4 years of proven experience in HR administration, recruiting, or generalist roles.

Skills: Strong proficiency in HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, ADP, BambooHR), Microsoft Office Suite, and deep knowledge of labor laws (such as FMLA and ADA).

title: Long-Form YouTube Vlog Editor Needed (Ongoing, Starting with 1 Paid Test)
description:
About the channel:

I run a lifestyle/vlog YouTube channel about living in Japan as a British-Filipina — culture, language learning, travel, and daily life. Videos are 20-30 min vlogs, mostly solo-filmed, sometimes with my partner. Tone is warm, real, and a little chaotic-funny, not overly polished or corporate.



What I need:

- Cut raw footage into a tight, watchable vlog (trim dead space, keep pacing snappy)

- Add captions/subtitles (burned-in, clean style)

- Basic colour correction

- Add simple text overlays for Japanese/Tagalog/English words when I code-switch (I'll flag these in notes)

- Light sound design — trim awkward silences, smooth audio levels

- Add my intro/outro (I'll provide)



What I'll provide:

- Raw footage + voice notes on story structure

- A reference video showing the pacing/style I like

- Brand fonts/colours if you're adding lower thirds



Turnaround: 

5-7 days for the test video



Budget: 

£30 for this test video (open to discussing an ongoing rate/retainer after, based on quality and turnaround)



To apply, please share:

- 2–3 examples of vlog or talking-head edits you've done (link a portfolio or drive folder)

- Your typical turnaround time

- Confirm you can add burned-in captions
